data.description:
Company Description

Solactive AG is a FinTech company operating globally and growing at a fast pace, headquartered in Frankfurt. Since 2007, we develop tailor-made and multi-asset class index solutions for ETFs and other index-linked investment products for the leading global investment banks and asset managers as our clients. Flexibility, efficiency, and providing the highest quality are at the heart and soul of our business philosophy. We are now hiring!


Job Overview

Our Market Data team forms an essential link between our business and infrastructure teams: it defines and implements business processes in data pipelines, monitors existing services, and thereby provides the best service to our customers. As a Senior Software Developer in our Market Data team, you will be working on a broad set of real-world problems. Highly effective data management, resilience, and fail-over strategies are some of our most important topics. In close collaboration with our business analysts and data engineers, you will create high-performance data processing solutions that scale using emerging technologies and approaches and help us define new best practices. 

Our continuous business growth and high requirements on accuracy, performance, and availability will provide you with a lot of engineering challenges and opportunities to contribute, to learn, and to grow as part of our team.   

You love solving complex problems, building performant, scalable, low latency, and highly available services. Then we can’t wait to meet you!


Your Tasks

  • Designing and implementing challenging projects to develop our data processing pipeline.
  • Building up a data landscape that acts as the single source of all relevant data in the long run.
  • Engineering ETL processes.
  • Developing high performance APIs and streaming solutions to our clients and data vendors.
  • Being an in-house consultant for best track, store, and access data.


Your Profile

  • 8+ years of software development, data engineering, or relevant experience, including at least 5 years of in-depth Python experience.
  • Software Engineering: good understanding of microservice architectures, Liskov’s Substitution Principle, design patterns, and dynamic dispatch.
  • Databases: experience with at least one SQL/NoSQL database, such as MongoDB, PostgreSQL, or MySQL, including schema definition and evolution, as well as ORM frameworks such as SQLAlchemy, JPA, or Hibernate.
  • Cloud / Cloud-native development: Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • CI/CD: ability to define build pipelines and perform, validate, and monitor deployments.
  • Good understanding of microservice architectures.
  • Ability to define Docker images according to the Twelve-Factor App methodology.
  • Git: ability to use Git from the command line and apply version-control management practices (e.g., Gitflow, trunk-based development).
  • Strong technical mentoring skills.
  • Full professional proficiency in English.
  • Communication: ability to illustrate ideas and concepts with figurative examples to both stakeholders and developers.
  • Ability to perceive the business domain in terms of mathematical structures is appreciated.


Our Offer

  • Be part of the Solactive family, a motivated team with an international setting.
  • Get to know the dynamics of an established, successful FinTech company.
  • Free choice of your gears to work comfortably and effectively.
  • Experience a modern start-up culture with a flat hierarchy.
  • Seize the opportunity to develop personally, take over responsibility and maintain direct customer contact from day one.
  • Flexible work environment with a hybrid work model and 30 annual vacation days.
  • Receive numerous benefits (e.g. Regular staff parties, team events, access to Corporate Benefits, modern office space, activity room, free beverages and fruit baskets).

Bei pixx.io bist du Teil eines ambitionierten und unterstützenden Teams, das ein gemeinsames Ziel verfolgt: Unseren über 1.600 Kunden eine erstklassige SaaS-Lösung für Digital Asset Management (DAM) zu bieten und gleichzeitig neue Unternehmen von unserer Software zu begeistern. Gemeinsam machen wir digitales Arbeiten smarter und erfolgreicher – und du kannst einen wichtigen Beitrag dazu leisten.

Freue dich auf:

  • ein Marketing-Team, das Themen eigenverantwortlich vorantreibt und dich als zentrale Schnittstelle für Events und Partnerschaften willkommen heißt,
  • direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing-, Sales- und Partner-Verantwortlichen sowie sichtbaren Impact auf unsere GTM-Strategie,
  • moderne und nachhaltige Büros in Mühldorf (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mVc3LBJ8C9Q) und in München (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9hoq8-16O48), wobei du frei auswählen kannst, ob du an einem unserer Standorte (gerne auch hybrid) arbeitest – was wir bevorzugen würden – oder remote innerhalb Deutschlands,
  • echte gelebte Hybrid Kultur: 2 On-Sites pro Jahr in unserem Headquarter für Workshops & Teambuildings in Persona,
  • unbefristete Festanstellung in Vollzeit (40 Std.) ab 01.01.2027,
  • 30 Urlaubstage + jeweils einen freien Tag am 24.12. und 31.12.,
  • marktgerechtes Gehalt je nach Skill- und Erfahrungslevel,
  • offene Fehler- und Feedbackkultur,
  • tolle Weiterbildungs- und Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten,
  • modernste Ausstattung, ergonomische Arbeitsplätze im Büro, Mitarbeitende werben Mitarbeitende-Programm, Zusammenhalt fördernde Events und spaßige Firmenfeiern, faire Regelungen zu Workations innerhalb der EU, vergünstigte Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft, Corporate Benefits & Co.


Deine Aufgaben

Du behältst bei mehreren Projekten gleichzeitig den Überblick, denkst in Prozessen und liebst es, Events und Partnerschaften von der Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung zu bringen? Dann bist du hier genau richtig! Du als (Senior) Marketing Manager – Events & Partnerships (d/w/m*) verantwortest unsere Marketing Kanäle Events und Partnerships vollumfänglich – von der Strategie bis zur operativen Umsetzung.

Was dich erwartet:

  • Messe- & Event-Management: Du planst und steuerst unsere Auftritte auf Messen wie der DMEXCO und der K5 von Stand- und Eventkonzept über Budget, Bewerbung und Durchführung bis hin zur Nachbereitung inklusive Lead-Übergabe an den Vertrieb.
  • Online Events: Du planst und steuerst unsere Webinare, egal ob selbst gehostet oder durch Partner/Plattformen. Bei dir laufen alle Fäden zusammen von der Konzeption über Projektmanagement bis zur Erfolgskontrolle.
  • Partner-Marketing & Enablement: Du konzipierst und organisierst Formate wie Meet-ups oder einen virtuellen Partner-Day und baust unser Partner-Enablement kontinuierlich aus.
  • Schnittstellenfunktion: Du arbeitest als Teil des Marketings eng mit Sales, CSM und externen Partnern zusammen und stellst sicher, dass alle Projekte termingerecht, budgetkonform und mit klarem Erfolgsmaß umgesetzt werden.


Dein Profil

Bei uns zählt jede einzelne Person – dein Impact macht den Unterschied. Wir suchen eine Person, die unsere Kanäle 'Events' & 'Partnerships' nicht nur organisiert, sondern strategisch weiterentwickelt – mit Hands-on-Mentalität und einem Gespür für Priorisierung.

Idealerweise bringst du zudem folgende Qualifikationen mit:

  • Erfahrung im Marketing (Events, Partnerships): Du hast mindestens 4-5 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B Marketing, am Besten mit Kampagnen- oder Eventmanagement Schwerpunkt, bevorzugt in der SaaS oder Tech-Branche.
  • Budget- & Ressourcenkontrolle: Du hast Erfahrung in der effizienten Steuerung von Event- und Marketing-Budgets und behältst Kosten sowie Ressourceneinsatz jederzeit im Blick.
  • Verhandlungsgeschick: Du verhandelst sicher mit Partnern, Dienstleistern und Sponsoring-Partnern und erzielst dabei für beide Seiten Deals mit Mehrwert.
  • Analytisches Mindset: Du misst und analysierst den Erfolg deiner Maßnahmen anhand klarer KPIs und triffst Entscheidungen datenbasiert statt aus dem Bauch heraus. Du hast immer einen Blick darauf, wo wir noch effizienter werden können und wo Potenziale für Skalierung liegen.
  • Organisationstalent mit Umsetzungsstärke: Du behältst bei mehreren parallelen Projekten den Überblick, setzt Prioritäten und lieferst zuverlässig termingerecht.
  • Eigenverantwortung: Du übernimmst Ownership für deine Projekte und triffst Entscheidungen eigenständig, ohne dabei den Blick fürs große Ganze zu verlieren.
  • Reisebereitschaft: Du bist bereit, für Messen und Partner-Events gelegentlich zu reisen.
  • Deutsch (C1/C2) & Englisch (mind. B2): Du bewegst dich sicher in nationalen sowie internationalen Partnerbeziehungen.

Intro

Willkommen bei Sanoptis – einem führenden Netzwerk moderner Augenkliniken und augenärztlicher Praxen mit über 480 Standorten in ganz Europa. Unsere Vision ist es, Wohlbefinden und Lebensqualität durch erstklassige augenärztliche Behandlung zu verbessern. Unser innovatives, dezentrales Modell ermöglicht es unseren Partnerstandorten, unabhängig zu operieren und sich auf die individuellen Bedürfnisse ihrer Patienten zu konzentrieren. Gleichzeitig sind sie Teil eines größeren Netzwerks mit starken Partnern, das ihnen Synergieeffekte, modernste Technik und viele weitere Vorteile bietet.

Du bist ein Talent-Experte und weißt, wie eine Arbeitgebermarke repräsentativ zu etablieren ist und die besten Talente zu gewinnen sind?

In unserem People-Team bist Du für den gesamten Rekrutierungsprozess der Sanoptis-Gruppe verantwortlich. Du steuerst die Besetzung unserer offenen Stellen in 6 europäischen Ländern (DACH, Spanien, Italien, Griechenland). Du entwickelst und etablierst Best Practices, um die Standardisierung zu erhöhen und Synergien innerhalb unseres Netzwerks zu nutzen. Gemeinsam mit uns etablierst Du Sanoptis als den Employer-of-Choice am Markt.

Die Position ist zunächst als Elternzeitvertretung auf 18 Monate befristet.


In dieser Rolle wirst Du

  • Unsere Recruiting-Prozesse entwerfen und steuern: Du trägst die Verantwortung für alle Rekrutierungsaktivitäten der Sanoptis-Gruppe, einschließlich Stellenbeschreibungen, Kanalplanung, Active Sourcing, Bewerberauswahl und Durchführung von Erstgesprächen.
  • Unsere Metriken im Blick behalten und auswerten: Du wirst unsere KPI-Dashboards zur Überwachung der Leistung von Rekrutierungsaktivitäten steuern, auswerten und daraus Daten und evidenzbasierte Handlungen ableiten.
  • Unsere Recruitment-Partner intern und extern steuern: Du wirst Partner wie Stellenportale, Headhunter oder Personalagenturen steuern, Verträge prüfen und Preise verhandeln, um uns stets den besten Zugang zu Talenten zu sichern. Dabei steuerst Du auch Rekrutierungskampagnen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Marketingteam. Zusätzlich schulst Du die Personalverantwortlichen der Kliniken zur Verbesserung ihrer Recruitingaktivitäten.

  • Unsere Employer-Brand-Strategie umsetzen: Du stärkst die Sanoptis Employer Brand und entwickelst unsere Außenauftrittem, insbesondere auf LinkedIn, kununu und weiteren relevanten Plattformen, kontinuierlich weiter.


Du wirst zusammenarbeiten mit

  • Der Head of People Angelina Budes als Deine Führungskraft.

  • Entscheidungsträgern wie Head-ofs, C-Level Executives und Hiring Managern, wenn es um die Einstellung der besten Talente geht.
  • Vielen weiteren Stakeholdern im gesamten Unternehmen durch Hiring-Prozesse, Trainings und weitere Recruiting-Maßnahmen, die Du leitest.


Dein Profil überzeugt durch

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Recruiting oder Personalwesen.
  • Erfahrung im internationalen Stakeholder-Management. Idealerweise hast Du bereits in einem Private-Equity-Umfeld gearbeitet.
  • Affinität zu KI-Anwendungen, insbesondere Claude; praktische Erfahrung mit KI-gestützten Recruiting-Prozessen und -Projekten ist ein Plus.
  • Erfahrung mit ATS-Systemen (z.B. Personio).
  • Ausgeprägte analytische, konzeptionelle und strategische Fähigkeiten und idealerweise Erfahrung im Projektmanagement.
  • Emotionale Intelligenz sowie hervorragende zwischenmenschliche und kommunikative Fähigkeiten.
  • Deutschkenntnisse auf C2-Niveau sowie Englischkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau.

  • Inklusive Kultur: Arbeite in einem talentierten und vielfältigen Team mit einer herzlichen Bürokultur und Teamveranstaltungen.
  • Mitarbeiterrabatte: Vergünstigte Konditionen auf zahlreiche ausgewählte Markenprodukte und Dienstleistungen über unseren Partner Corporate Benefits.
  • Flexible steuerfreie Benefits: Ein individuelles Benefit-Budget von monatlich 50 €, welches nach persönlichen Bedürfnissen gestaltet und steuerfrei genutzt werden kann.

data.description:
Wir wollen die lautesten Handpulled Noodles Europas werden. Dafür fehlt uns die Person, die das kreativ führt.

Bang Bang Noodles macht Handpulled Noodles. Jede Nudel von Hand gezogen, mitten im Restaurant, so dass du es siehst, hörst und spürst. Heute zwei Stores in Berlin, Kreuzberg und Mitte. Morgen deutlich mehr: Wir bauen gerade das Franchise System auf und wollen im nächsten Jahr fünf weitere Standorte eröffnen, auch außerhalb Berlins. Dazu ein starkes Team und ein Markengesicht, das schon heute Reichweite hat.

Not authentic. Just really good. Wir erzählen keine Traditionsgeschichten. Wir zeigen, was wir können, und wir sind dabei laut. Mit Absicht.

Was uns fehlt, ist die Person, die diese Haltung jeden Tag in Content, Kampagnen und Markenauftritt übersetzt. Nicht als Verwalter, sondern als Motor.

Aufgaben

  • Du führst die Marke. Tonalität, Look, Guidelines, und du hast das letzte Wort bei allem, was BBN nach außen zeigt: Content, Karte, Stores, Merch, Kooperationen.
  • Du baust unser Content System. Formate für TikTok, Reels und Stories, ein Redaktionsplan, feste Drehroutinen mit unserer Gründerin als Gesicht und der Küche als Bühne.
  • Du produzierst selbst. Handy raus, drei Clips in der Küche, schneiden, posten. Du bist dabei nicht allein: Im Team gibt es Leute, die filmen und schneiden können und dich an festen Tagen unterstützen, und für größere Drehs holst du Freelancer und führst sie.
  • Du entwickelst Brand Momente, die Berlin mitbekommt, von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung, und steuerst Agenturen und Freelancer, wenn es welche braucht.
  • Du lieferst Creatives für Paid Social und holst dir die Learnings zurück in die Planung. Paid selbst liegt aktuell beim Founder und kann perspektivisch zu dir wandern.
  • Du bringst die Marke in jeden Kiez. Lokales Marketing für die bestehenden Stores und vor allem für Neueröffnungen: Launch Kampagnen, Nachbarschaft, Creator, Events. Beim Opening bist du vor Ort, auch wenn es in einer anderen Stadt ist.
  • Du machst die Marke auch nach innen sichtbar: Employer Brand für unser Recruiting und Material und Playbooks für unsere Franchise Partner, damit jeder Standort so laut ist wie der erste.
  • Du hast ein eigenes Produktionsbudget und entscheidest, wofür es draufgeht.

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens fünf Jahre in Brand, Content oder Kreation, angestellt oder in der Agentur. Und du hast an mindestens einer Marke mitgearbeitet, die man erkennt, weil sie Charakter hat. Consumer, Food, Lifestyle, egal welche Branche.
  • Du kannst es selbst. Kurze Videos mit dem Handy drehen und schneiden, Texte schreiben, Plattformen bedienen. Kein Profi Cutter nötig, aber auch kein reiner Stratege.
  • Du verstehst TikTok und Instagram aus der Praxis, nicht aus Reports.
  • Geschmack und Haltung. Du sagst nein, wenn etwas nicht zur Marke passt, auch zu uns.
  • Deutsch und Englisch sicher. Du bist in Berlin und willst in den Stores sein, nicht nur im Büro.
  • Reisebereitschaft. Bei Openings in anderen Städten bist du für ein paar Tage dabei, das gehört zum Job.

Benefits

  • 60.000 bis 75.000 € brutto, je nach Erfahrung.
  • Direkte Freigabe ohne Schleifen. Du sprichst mit den Gründern, nicht mit einem Komitee.
  • Eigenes Office in Berlin für Konzept und Schnitt, die Stores als Set direkt vor der Tür.
  • Eigenes Produktionsbudget und Freelancer, die du selbst auswählst.
  • Eine Marke mit fertigem Fundament und ohne fertige Antworten. Vision, Werte und Tonalität stehen, alles andere baust du.
  • Eine Firma, die gerade den Sprung ins Franchise macht. Was du jetzt aufbaust, wird die Vorlage für jeden weiteren Standort. Und die Rolle wächst mit: Wer heute die Marke für zwei Stores führt, führt in zwei Jahren ein Team.
  • Weiterbildung ist uns wichtig. Eigenes Budget für Kurse, Konferenzen und Coaching, du entscheidest, was dich weiterbringt.
  • Noodles. So viele du willst.

So läuft es ab: Du bewirbst dich mit Portfolio oder Arbeitsproben und beantwortest eine Frage: Was würdest du bei uns als Erstes lauter machen? Kein Anschreiben. Dann ein erstes Gespräch mit den Gründern, 30 Minuten, Haltung und Fit. Danach ein bezahlter Case: dein 90 Tage Plan für BBN, präsentiert im Store. Zum Schluss ein zweites Gespräch zu Rahmen und Vertrag. Vom ersten Kontakt bis zur Entscheidung: maximal vier Wochen.

Made loud.

data.title: Head of Brand & Marketing (m/w/d)

data.description:
Rund 74 % aller CO₂-Emissionen in Deutschland entstehen im Zusammenhang mit der Energieproduktion, das sind über 543 Millionen Tonnen pro Jahr.

Um die europäischen Klimaziele zu erreichen, müssen wir dieses Problem dringend und entschlossen angehen, und genau hier setzen wir bei Sunpeak Capital an.

Wir machen den Ausbau erneuerbarer Energien investierbar und verwandeln Photovoltaik, Batteriespeicher und Ladeinfrastruktur in renditestarke, steueroptimierte Investments. Unser Ansatz verbindet Klimaschutz mit finanzieller Intelligenz: ein echtes Win-Win für Umwelt und Investoren.

Mit unserer Kombination aus spezialisierten Beratungsprozessen, innovativen Investmentstrukturen und einem breiten Netzwerk aus Projektentwicklern ermöglichen wir privaten und unternehmerischen Investoren, den Energiewandel aktiv mitzugestalten, profitabel und nachhaltig.

Wir skalieren unser Modell konsequent innerhalb Deutschlands, dort, wo die Energiewende entschieden wird. Werde Teil unseres Teams und trage dazu bei, dass Kapitalströme dorthin fließen, wo sie größten Klimanutzen und echte Rendite erzeugen.

Aufgaben

Deine Rolle

Du baust unser Marketing gemeinsam mit den Gründern auf der grünen Wiese auf. Vieles existiert noch nicht, einiges läuft bereits: Du bringst neue Kanäle und Prozesse von 0 auf 1 und skalierst bestehende von 1 auf 10. Content, Newsletter und Performance-Marketing liegen bei dir, von der Strategie bis zur Umsetzung. Du entscheidest, was priorisiert wird, verantwortest die Ergebnisse und stehst auch selbst vor der Kamera. Wir suchen keine Person, die Briefings abarbeitet, sondern jemanden, der das Thema Growth bei Sunpeak Capital zu 100% eigenverantwortlich ownt.

  • Marketing- und Growth-Strategie: Du entwickelst mit den Gründern die Growth-Strategie, definierst Zielgruppen, Kanäle, Budgets und KPIs und verantwortest die Umsetzung Ende-zu-Ende.
  • Content-Marketing von 0 auf 1 und von 1 auf 10: Du konzipierst und produzierst YouTube-Videos, Podcasts, LinkedIn- und Instagram-Formate, stehst selbst vor der Kamera und drehst mit unseren Gründern. Schnitt, Postproduktion, Thumbnails und die Adaption von Longform-Content in Reels und Shorts gehören dazu.
  • Newsletter-Marketing: Unser E-Mail-Marketing läuft bereits. Du entwickelst es weiter: Segmentierung, Automationen, Inhalte und Lead Nurturing entlang der gesamten Investor Journey optimierst du kontinuierlich auf Öffnungsraten, Engagement und Conversion.
  • Performance-Marketing: Unsere bezahlten Kampagnen (Meta, Google, LinkedIn, YouTube) übernimmst du und gehst stark ins Testing: neue Kampagnen, Creatives, Zielgruppen und Landingpages. Remarketing baust du neu auf. Alles ist Tracking-, Zahlen- und KPI-getrieben; du wertest die Performance regelmäßig aus und optimierst konsequent auf Lead-Qualität und Akquisitionskosten.
  • Brand: Du entwickelst weiter, wie Sunpeak klingt und aussieht, und ziehst die Brand konsequent durch alle Touchpoints, von Social Media über Investorenmaterialien bis zu internen Präsentationen.
  • Funnel und Daten: Du verbindest Marketing und Vertrieb, arbeitest eng mit unserem CRM (HubSpot) und machst sichtbar, welche Maßnahmen tatsächlich Investoren bringen.
  • AI-First: Du baust unser Marketing AI-first auf und hebst mit AI-Tools Effizienzen in allen Bereichen: bei der Content-Erstellung, im Schnitt, bei Creatives, in der Auswertung von Kampagnen und in der Automatisierung von Prozessen. Was manuell nicht sein muss, wird es bei dir auch nicht. Das Budget für die passenden Tools stellen wir, welche das sind, entscheidest du.
  • Perspektive: Mit wachsendem Erfolg baust du dein eigenes Team auf und führst Praktikanten, Werkstudenten und Freelancer.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast 2 bis 3 Jahre Arbeitserfahrung im Growth- oder Marketing-Bereich eines Startups oder Scale-ups und einen Proven Track Record: Kanäle, Kampagnen oder Prozesse, die du messbar aufgebaut oder skaliert hast
  • Du bist hands-on in mindestens zwei der drei Bereiche Content, Newsletter und Performance-Marketing und hast Lust, den dritten zu meistern
  • Du arbeitest dich sehr schnell tief in erneuerbare Energien, Photovoltaik, Batteriespeicher und die steuerliche Logik unserer Investments ein. Nur wer das Produkt versteht, kann dafür Marketing machen, das Investoren überzeugt
  • Du arbeitest datengetrieben: Tracking, Attribution, A/B-Tests und Reporting sind für dich Werkzeuge, keine BuzzwordsDu hast ein gutes Auge für Ästhetik und Storytelling und Erfahrung im Videoschnitt, idealerweise auch mit Kamera, Ton und Licht
  • Du stehst selbst gerne vor der Kamera oder bist bereit, es zu lernenDu verstehst, wie YouTube, LinkedIn und Instagram funktionieren, im Short- wie im Longform-BereichDu arbeitest AI-first: AI-Tools sind für dich in Content-Produktion, Auswertung und Automatisierung fester Teil des Workflows, und du suchst aktiv nach weiteren Hebeln, um schneller und besser zu werden
  • Du arbeitest mit hoher Autonomie, triffst Entscheidungen selbst und übernimmst Verantwortung für Ergebnisse, auch wenn es unbequem wirdSehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und ein sicheres Gespür für Sprache und Tonalität
  • Du bist verfügbar für eine Vollzeitstelle und bereit, an 5 Tagen pro Woche in unserem Berliner Büro zu arbeitenBonus: Du bringst bereits Vorkenntnisse in erneuerbaren Energien oder Energiemärkten mit oder hast Erfahrung im Marketing für Finanz- oder Investmentprodukte

Benefits

  • Ownership und Impact: Du baust das Marketing von Sunpeak Capital von Anfang an mit auf, arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern und hast prägenden Einfluss darauf, wie wir am Markt wahrgenommen werden
  • Kompetitive Vergütung: Top Leistung wird bei uns auch adäquat bezahlt**.**
  • Kostenfreie Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft: Power dich nach der Arbeit aus beim Sport.
  • Modernes Office in Berlin Mitte: Kaffee in Barista-Qualität, ergonomische Designer-Möbel und technisches Top-Setup (Apple Hardware + XXL Screens).
  • Regelmäßige Team-Events: Gemeinsame Aktivitäten wie Surfen oder eine Bootsfahrt stärken das Miteinander und machen die Zeit bei uns noch besser.
  • Bezahlte Lunches: Wir sorgen für dein leibliches Wohl.
  • Workation: Anfang 2027 reist wir gemeinsam für 2 Wochen nach Kapstadt.

Über uns

Sunpeak Capital entstand aus der gemeinsamen Vision von Konstantin und Jan. Vor der Gründung waren sie die ersten beiden Mitarbeiter des Fintech-Scale-ups Cloover, welches PV-Anlagen finanziert. Für dieses bauten sie den deutschen Markt auf und skalierten und das Partnernetzwerk auf über 200 Installationsbetriebe. In dieser Zeit erkannten sie, welches Potenzial entsteht, wenn man Kapital gezielt in nachhaltige Energieprojekte lenkt.

Anfang 2025 gründeten sie dann Sunpeak Capital - vollständig gebootstrapped und bereits nach zwei Monaten profitabel. Ihr Antrieb: die Mechanismen des Kapitalmarkts nutzen, um den Ausbau erneuerbarer Energien zu beschleunigen und Investoren echte Rendite mit echtem Impact zu ermöglichen.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

data.description:
80% of the world's workforce doesn't sit at a desk. Ordio 💙 is the all-in-one platform that helps these teams run their day: shift planning, time tracking, absence & document management. Simple, fast, and human.

We're at an exciting stage of growth: around €5m ARR, with strong foundations in DACH, new products in market, and international expansion underway. Marketing now has the opportunity to become a major growth lever for the business connecting brand, demand generation, product and sales into one commercial engine.

We’re looking for a senior, commercially minded marketing leader to build and scale Ordio’s marketing engine for the next stage of growth.

You’ll own Marketing end to end, with clear accountability for pipeline, new ARR and efficient growth. You’ll work closely with the CEO, Sales and Product to sharpen our positioning, scale acquisition, improve conversion, and expand a successful GTM motion into new European markets.

The opportunity is to build the next version of Ordio’s marketing organisation and grow with the company toward a true CMO level role as Ordio scales toward €20–50m ARR.

Tasks

  • Own Ordio’s marketing strategy, budget and operating cadence, with a clear focus on pipeline, customers, ARR, CAC and payback.
  • Build and scale a measurable demand generation engine across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, organic, content and SEO.
  • Go deep into campaign performance, creative, landing pages and conversion — not just manage agencies or dashboards.
  • Own the full funnel from first touch through Closed Won, including lifecycle, CRM, nurture and conversion optimisation.
  • Sharpen Ordio’s positioning and messaging, translating an increasingly broad product suite into simple, differentiated customer value.
  • Raise the bar on brand and creative quality while maintaining strong commercial accountability.
  • Work closely with Sales on shared pipeline and revenue goals.
  • Partner with Product on launches, self-service, trials, PLG experiments and conversion loops.
  • Build the right team, processes, reporting and agency/freelancer setup as the function grows.
  • Help internationalise Ordio’s acquisition engine and establish repeatable GTM playbooks for new European markets.

Requirements

  • Significant in house experience in B2B SaaS / software.
  • Experience scaling a SaaS company through a comparable growth stage, ideally somewhere between €3–10m ARR and €15–30m+ ARR.
  • Strong experience with high-volume SMB / Lower Mid-Market acquisition, rather than only enterprise ABM.
  • A proven ability to generate measurable pipeline, customers and revenue through marketing.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of Google, Meta and LinkedIn, ideally having owned meaningful budgets of €100k+ per month.
  • Strong command of CAC, CPL, conversion, payback, pipeline economics and ARR.
  • A full-funnel mindset: you think from acquisition through Closed Won, not just MQL generation.
  • Strong understanding of brand, positioning, messaging and creative quality alongside performance marketing.
  • Good understanding of content, SEO, lifecycle, CRM and conversion optimisation.
  • Experience working closely with Sales on shared revenue targets and Product on launches, PLG and positioning.
  • Experience leading and developing a marketing team while remaining willing to go deep into campaigns, numbers and execution.
  • A genuine builder mentality: you’ve built or materially improved teams, processes, reporting and acquisition engines.
  • Fluent German and business-fluent English.

Benefits

💰 Competitive compensation & benefits

🚀 True ownership of a core growth function with direct impact on pipeline and ARR

🧠 A steep learning curve across growth, product, international expansion and company building

💻 Top-tier equipment (MacBook Pro M4 or higher)

🏡 Flexible setup: Hybrid or fully remote within Germany

💪 Well-being support: Subsidized gym memberships, wellness initiatives, Jobrad

🌎 Guided by our values: Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, Earth Is

At Ordio 💙, we're looking for people who want to be more than just another employee: ambitious, forward-thinking, and ready to shape the future of work.

If you want to build the marketing engine behind Ordio’s next stage of growth, work closely with the CEO, Sales and Product, and have real ownership over how we scale across Europe, we'd love to hear from you..

Ordio is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

data.title: VP Marketing (m/f/d)

data.description:
The Role

We are seeking a Controls Engineer (m/f/d) to work on the local controller that runs at the heart of our customers' power plants. You will design and build the control logic that keeps solar, BESS, and thermal generation assets operating safely and efficiently. A passion for the energy transition and interest in physical systems behind the code is highly valued.

Tasks

What You’ll Do:

  • Design and maintain control algorithms for our Rust-based controller.
  • Translate control theory and power grid compliance requirements into clean, well-tested code.
  • Collaborate on the development of control algorithms for power distribution, anomaly detection, error handling and electric/thermal/economic optimization.
  • Collaborate with engineers to validate controller behavior against real-world conditions.
  • Build software interfaces to communicate directly with plant hardware via protocols like Modbus, CAN, and M-Bus.
  • Support commissioning, testing, and troubleshooting of controllers.

Requirements

What You Bring:

  • Experience in Rust, or strong proficiency in another systems language such as C/C++.
  • Comfort with concurrent, real-time, programming close to the hardware layer.
  • Knowledge of, or strong curiosity about control systems or power systems.
  • Clear, proactive communication skills.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with industrial protocols (Modbus, CAN, M-Bus).
  • Background in power systems, solar assets, battery energy storage systems (BESS) or similar.

Benefits

Why join H.E.A.T.?

  • Future-Proof Career: Gain deep knowledge of the fast growing renewable energy sector and accelerate the global energy transition.
  • High Autonomy: Work independently in a top-performing, diverse team with fast decisions and minimal bureaucracy.
  • Early-Stage Equity: Receive company equity and have abundant opportunities for personal development
  • Flexibility: Central Berlin office with hybrid remote options and flexible working hours.
  • Growth & Pay: Competitive salary, generous personal development support, and fast career progression

Ready to apply your engineering skills to a future-proof industry that truly matters? Click Apply Now and get to know us better!

Join BLP Digital — The #1 Solution for ERP Automation

BLP Digital is redefining ERP automation with agentic AI. Spun out of ETH Zurich and HSG, we build AI agents that automate finance, procurement, logistics, sales, and more for some of the world's largest enterprises. We solve real enterprise problems with cutting-edge technology and a strong sense of ownership.

Our solution is live in 40+ countries, used by 550+ customers, and automates 70,000+ processes every day, including for Fortune 500 companies. As one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scaleups, our success stems from deep expertise in technology and business processes, delivering a product with outstanding product-market fit, proven by a growing global customer base.

We've recently welcomed Goldman Sachs Alternatives as a growth investor, and we're now expanding into the UK with the launch of our London office. We are just getting started. Ready to build the future? Join BLP Digital today.

About the position

We're giving you the keys to the machine. As our Applied AI Engineer, you'll have a founder-level mandate to build and ship AI-powered internal tools that make our hiring, finance and ops workflows 10x faster — not 10% faster. You'll work at the frontier of what's possible with LLMs, AI agents, and emerging AI tooling, and apply it where it matters most: inside our own company.

About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.


About the Role

This is a rare opportunity to build a truly strategic Deal Desk function at Perk — one that shapes how our Sales organisation structures, prices, and closes its most complex, high-value deals. We're investing in this transformation now, and we want a leader who can turn that ambition into reality.

We're hiring a Senior Deal Desk Manager to lead this shift. You'll take ownership of the Deal Desk team and its transformation, personally running point on our most complex and strategic deals while building a team that operates as trusted commercial partners to Sales, Finance, and Legal. A major part of the role will be modernising how the team works: automating manual processes through AI and automation, and improving our CPQ and quoting systems so Sales can move faster with confidence.

This is a coach-player role: you'll lead and develop a team while staying hands-on with the deals that matter most.


What You'll Do

Lead the transformation

  • Rebuild Deal Desk's operating model so the team spends its time on complex deal structuring and pricing strategy for high-value opportunities, not manual admin like company setup or payment profile processing — and put in place the triage, tools, and ways of working that make that shift stick.

  • Decide what Deal Desk should own, support, automate, or hand off to other teams, and build the case for change with Legal, Finance, and Sales Operations leadership.

  • Agree clear ownership and service levels for work that moves to other teams (for example, NDAs, supplier and financial forms, payment term changes, and downgrade/churn processing), so handovers actually stick.

  • Build performance metrics and reporting to track deal velocity, team output, and the impact of process and automation improvements over time.

  • Represent Deal Desk as a trusted, credible partner in cross-functional forums and with Sales leadership.

Lead the team and run point on complex deals

  • Build, lead, and develop a team of Deal Desk professionals, setting clear goals and performance standards as the team matures into a more strategic function.

  • Act as a coach-player: personally run point on Perk's most complex, highest-value deals, modelling the standard of deal structuring, negotiation support, and stakeholder management expected of the team.

  • Own pricing governance and deal structuring for complex, non-standard commercial deals, balancing commercial risk with deal velocity.

  • Mentor the team on complex deal structuring, pricing strategy, and commercial risk judgement, and coach them through escalations.

  • Partner with Legal, Finance, Sales Operations, and Product to unblock deals and resolve cross-functional friction quickly.

Own our systems and quoting experience

  • Own the relationship with our CPQ platform end to end, bringing prior experience owning a complex CPQ implementation elsewhere.

  • Identify and drive improvements to CPQ configuration, pricing logic, and quoting workflows so Sales can quote and close faster with confidence.

  • Act as the primary Deal Desk voice in Revenue Systems and CPQ/CLM tooling roadmap decisions.

Drive automation and AI

  • Own the automation roadmap for Deal Desk, with a clear mandate to remove manual, repetitive work from the team through AI and automation.

  • Prioritise and deliver automation of the highest-impact manual workflows first, such as company and payment profile setup and post-signature subscription provisioning, which today account for a significant share of the team's ticket volume.

  • Partner with engineering/systems teams to scope, sequence, and deliver automation initiatives, and track the time saved and volume shifted off manual processing.

  • Evaluate and pilot AI tools for use cases such as contract redline review, NDA triage, and deal risk flagging, working closely with Legal.

Protect the business

  • Act as Deal Desk's first line of defense on contract redlines and non-standard deal terms, escalating to Legal or Finance where needed.

  • Own commercial governance frameworks, pricing and discounting policy, and approval structures across the function.

  • Safeguard deal commercials, business risk, and revenue recognition implications on complex and non-standard deals.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong Deal Desk experience within B2B SaaS, ideally spanning mid-market and enterprise segments.

  • Proven experience leading a Deal Desk (or equivalent commercial/sales operations) team, with direct people management responsibility.

  • A genuine coach-player: comfortable personally running complex, high-value deals while simultaneously leading and developing a team.

  • Prior ownership of a complex CPQ platform, with a track record of driving measurable improvements to quoting, pricing, and deal velocity for Sales.

  • Experience scoping and delivering automation and/or AI initiatives that reduce manual operational work, ideally in partnership with engineering or systems teams.

  • Strong cross-functional stakeholder management skills, comfortable partnering across Legal, Finance, Sales Operations, and Product.

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-changing, ambiguous environment where processes are still being defined and improved.


What We Offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk.

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays.

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex.

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva.

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen.

  • Rest assured that you're covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence.

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus.

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party.

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks' paid parental leave.

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes.

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year.

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards.

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years.

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support.

AI at Perk

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled, so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

We don't expect you to be an AI expert, but we do expect you to be curious and intentional about it. The bar is judgment: knowing when AI makes your work better, when to verify what it produces, and when to rely on your own expertise instead.

We'll ask about how you use AI in your interviews, not to test tool knowledge, but to understand how you think about it. That reflects how we work every day.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

 

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

We’re looking for a Lead Business Analyst, Process & Automation to join our Capital and Payments team. Process & Automation is a small team working across the operations behind payments, lending, underwriting, risk, and billing. We find operational friction, diagnose root causes, and build the process, data, tooling, and automation solutions that fix it.

You will own projects end to end: find where a process is failing or create toil, prove it with data, design something better, coordinate the build with stakeholders, and stay with it until the receiving team owns it and the numbers have moved. AI is a default tool in how we work rather than a separate initiative.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role with full ownership of your projects.

 
 

What you’ll be doing:

  • Define: map end-to-end flows, trace handoffs, and understand how a process actually runs rather than how it is documented.

  • Diagnose: separate root causes from symptoms and quantify where time, money, and customers are being lost.

  • Design: turn what you find into clear requirements, better flows, and delivery plans with measurable success criteria, then build or coordinate the automation, tooling, data, and controls they depend on.

  • Instrument: lead testing and launch readiness, track impact against agreed measures, drive adoption, and hand ownership back to the team that owns the outcome.

  • Establish how we use AI agents in operations: identify where they create real leverage, then design, test, and deploy them for bounded, multi-step workflows, including the evaluation methods that prove they work.

  • Partner with teams outside operations whose work affects these outcomes, and turn operational findings into business cases that help Product and Technology prioritize longer-term solutions.

 
 

What you need to bring:

We're looking for a candidate who has experience with the following:

  • 7+ years in business analysis, process improvement, operations, implementation, or product operations.

  • A track record leading complex cross-functional projects from problem definition through implementation and ongoing measurement.

  • Strong analytical skills - you use data, queries, and dashboards to validate problems and prove outcomes, not only to report on them.

  • Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous business needs into clear requirements, process designs, and delivery plans.

  • Excellent stakeholder management, facilitation, written communication, and presentation skills, with a track record of driving alignment and outcomes across teams you do not manage.

 
 

Even better if you have, but not necessary:

  • Financial services, fintech, payments, lending, or insurance - or another complex, regulated operating environment.

  • Commerce, e-commerce, point-of-sale, or marketplace experience.

  • Hands-on experience with workflow, case-management, or process-automation platforms.

  • SQL, business-intelligence tools, or data modelling.

  • Experience evaluating or deploying AI-enabled solutions for operational use cases.

  • Experience driving adoption and effectiveness after launch, not just delivery.

We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try!

Be a changemaker

 
 

You’ll enjoy:

  • A flexible work environment that empowers you to do your best work

  • A culture that celebrates performance

  • The chance to make an impact in a team that’s big enough for career growth, but lean enough to make your voice heard

  • Career-defining opportunities

Plus benefits designed to keep you happy, healthy and fulfilled.

  • Flexible paid time off and remote work policies

  • Equity options, because this is your company too

  • Contributions to your pension plan. Your future matters

  • Training opportunities to grow your skills and career

  • Health and wellness credit so you feel your best

  • Time off to volunteer and give back to your community

  • Interest groups, employee led networks, social committees to sponsored sports teams

  • Computer purchase program to get your personal Macbook

  • Enhanced parental leave to support growing families

  • Etc…

 

Fuel your growth. Find your people.

At Lightspeed, your growth is our priority. We invest in you with continuous learning opportunities, global mobility and benefits designed to support you—all within a driven, diverse and inclusive team that’s passionate about empowering our communities

Please note that we ask applicants to disclose any criminal convictions, and we conduct criminal record checks as part of our hiring process for this role.

About us

Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.

As our Senior Strategic Project Manager within the Office of the CEO, you will be a primary execution driver behind our most critical cross-functional initiatives. You will serve as the strategic bridge connecting executive leadership with operational, regulatory, product, and business teams across our Luxembourg and Milan hubs.

While you will work side-by-side with internal Legal, Compliance, and Risk experts who own the regulatory subject matter, your core strength is senior strategic leadership and project execution: acting as a key leader within the organization to orchestrate complex initiatives across different verticals, driving high-impact project timelines, and turning corporate obligations into seamless operational workflows.

Here's what that looks like in practice:

  • Solve complex business challenges - Tackling intricate business problems by developing innovative, data-backed solutions with a consistent user-first approach.

  • Stakeholder management and strategic partnership - Managing relationships with C-level stakeholders and acting as a thought partner for leadership on specific strategic areas.

Strategic Finance Manager — The Flex

The Flex is creating the future of flexible accommodation.

We operate and manage properties across multiple cities and countries, bringing together hospitality, technology and operational excellence to make renting a home as effortless as booking a hotel.

As our international footprint expands, we are searching for an outstanding Strategic Finance Manager to help build the financial systems, controls and insights required to support a rapidly growing global business.

This is far more than a conventional accounting position. You will work closely with our founders and leadership team, take ownership of essential financial processes, evaluate business performance and provide the insights that enable better decisions as we scale.

Your Mission

As Strategic Finance Manager, you will play a central role in The Flex’s financial operations.

Your objective will be to give the business complete clarity over where its revenue comes from, how its money is spent, how each area is performing and where profitability can be improved.

Your responsibilities will span accounting, financial analysis, management reporting, payment reconciliation, budgeting and business performance.

You will have exposure to the entire organisation, collaborating directly with operations, revenue management, property teams and senior leadership.

For an ambitious individual, this position offers a clear path toward becoming Head of Finance or, ultimately, moving into a CFO-track role as The Flex continues to grow.

What You Will Own

  • Lead and continuously strengthen our day-to-day financial controls and reporting, ensuring that every number shared with management is accurate, validated, complete and supported by reliable evidence.

  • Identify repetitive and manual finance tasks, create more efficient processes and collaborate with our engineering teams to automate them.

  • Reconcile payments from Airbnb, Booking.com, Expedia, direct reservations and other distribution partners, confirming that every expected payment is received correctly and on schedule.

  • Reconcile bank accounts and incoming transactions, ensuring that funds are properly received and recorded while investigating and resolving discrepancies quickly.

  • Monitor and manage accounts payable and accounts receivable.

  • Review supplier invoices and expenses incurred across the company.

  • Oversee statutory filings and corporate compliance requirements across several jurisdictions, making sure that all submissions are correct and completed within the required deadlines.

  • Coordinate with external accountants, tax advisers, auditors and banking partners to maintain accurate financial records and ensure timely compliance.

  • Assist with financial statements for landlords and property owners whenever required.

  • Develop dashboards and reporting tools that provide management with real-time visibility into company performance.

  • Evaluate financial results across individual properties, cities, countries and business units.

  • Create and maintain company budgets, forecasts and financial models.

  • Track cash flow and support management in planning future funding and capital needs.

  • Detect financial risks, discrepancies and potential sources of revenue leakage.

  • Review the company’s cost base and uncover opportunities to strengthen margins.

  • Partner with operational teams to understand, control and reduce costs at property level.

  • Contribute to financial due diligence for acquisitions, investments and expansion into new markets.

  • Communicate financial findings, recommendations and actionable insights directly to the founders and management team.

What We Are Looking For

  • A highly analytical individual who is confident and comfortable working with numbers.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and an uncompromising approach to financial accuracy.

  • A strong understanding of accounting concepts and financial principles.

  • The ability to work effectively with significant volumes of financial and operational data.

  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets.

  • Strong capabilities in financial reconciliation, controls and problem-solving.

  • A commercial mindset—you do more than report figures; you understand their meaning and implications for the wider business.

  • A strong sense of ownership, responsibility and accountability.

  • The confidence to work independently, find solutions and navigate unfamiliar challenges.

  • The ability to perform in a fast-paced environment where priorities may evolve quickly.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • The confidence to communicate and work directly with senior management.

  • A genuine interest in technology, automation and AI, together with the ability to identify opportunities to improve and automate finance processes.

  • The ambition to grow quickly and assume substantially greater responsibility over time.

  • Experience in accounting, audit, investment banking, private equity, FP&A, consulting, hospitality, real estate or a high-growth startup would be highly valuable.

  • A degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Mathematics or another analytical discipline is preferred, although exceptional applicants from other backgrounds are encouraged to apply.

What Success Will Look Like

During your first 6–12 months, you will have:

  • Developed a detailed understanding of the financial performance of every major area of The Flex.

  • Established dependable monthly management reporting across the company.

  • Ensured that payments from booking platforms and commercial partners are fully reconciled and that all expected funds are received.

  • Significantly improved visibility into cash flow, profitability and unit economics.

  • Uncovered meaningful opportunities to lower costs and improve margins.

  • Automated several finance processes that were previously completed manually.

  • Established yourself as a trusted financial partner to the founders and management team.

  • Taken responsibility for increasingly important areas of the company’s finance function.

Why Join The Flex?

  • Become part of a rapidly growing international business operating at the intersection of real estate, hospitality and technology.

  • Work closely and directly with the company’s founders and senior leaders.

  • Gain hands-on exposure to the financial operations of a business spanning multiple countries.

  • Influence profitability and contribute directly to major strategic and commercial decisions.

  • Help design and build the finance function instead of simply taking over an established set of processes.

  • Apply technology and AI to reimagine how a modern finance function should operate.

  • Take meaningful ownership and responsibility from your first day.

  • Receive a competitive salary together with performance-based incentives.

  • Benefit from exceptional long-term career progression as The Flex continues its international expansion.

You Should Not Apply If

  • You want a conventional corporate 9-to-5 position with limited and narrowly defined responsibilities.

  • You rely on someone else to continuously tell you what needs to be done.

  • You are uncomfortable taking responsibility and being accountable for the quality of your work.

  • You would rather report financial figures than understand, challenge and improve them.

  • You engage in workplace politics, gossip or conversations about colleagues behind their backs.

  • You are searching for a slow-moving, predictable role with limited career progression.

  • You do not aspire to become one of the very best in the world at what you do.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer in the customer organisation, you are the technical spearhead of monday.com's AI transformation motion for our most strategic customers. You will carry a portfolio of 1 to 2 strategic accounts, deeply embedded with C-level and technical teams to architect, build, and ship AI solutions in production, and you will be accountable for the business outcomes those engagements promised, not just the build.

This is part of a growing motion, and you will be joining a team that’s already working on active deployments.

Please note this is a hybrid position of 3 days/week in our London office.

About the Role

Enterprises don't struggle to access AI capability; they struggle to deploy it. Your job is closing that gap for a small portfolio of monday.com's highest-value customers. You will advise executives on AI-driven operational change, design and ship the systems that make it real, and feed what you learn back into the product with evidence, not anecdotes.

You will work with: monday AI agents, MCP-based integrations into customer systems, vibe apps, and production workflows. You will take these from discovery through architecture, build, rollout, and measurable adoption.

This is an autonomous, high-visibility role that shapes both customer outcomes and the future of forward-deployed engineering at monday.com.

What You'll Do

Strategic transformation. Embed with C-level stakeholders across your accounts to architect end-to-end AI solutions and scalable workflows that solve complex, mission-critical business pains. You own the narrative from pilot to full production rollout.

Outcome ownership. Your success metric is the business result the engagement committed to: adoption, workflow throughput, measurable ROI. You define the success criteria with the customer up front and you own getting there.

Build and ship. Design sophisticated platform configurations, build monday agents and vibe apps, wire MCP integrations into customer systems, and prototype custom scripts where the platform ends. Your leverage is architecture and judgment; your credibility is that you can build it yourself.

Eval-driven product feedback. Instrument your deployments, run evals against real customer workflows, and translate what you find into PRDs and roadmap input that changes what we build. You are a sensor for the product org, with data behind every claim.

Cross-functional leadership. Partner with Sales and CS as the technical authority on account strategy. Productize what you learn: patterns, agents, and assets from one account become reusable machinery for the whole motion.

What we promise

This role has been built with a direct line into the product roadmap, a mandate to productize rather than repeat, and outcome-based success criteria agreed before the build starts.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years building applications from scratch using TypeScript/Node.js/React, with full-stack depth

  • Experience leading hands-on projects end-to-end in a production environment, preferably client-facing

  • Background in Solution Architecture or Software Engineering with a strong grasp of AI/LLM systems: agent architectures, MCP or comparable tool-use protocols, evals, and prompt-to-production workflows

  • Experience navigating C-suite relationships and influencing executive decisions in ambiguous environments

  • Track record of turning one-off delivery work into reusable assets, product requirements, or repeatable playbooks

  • Entrepreneurial, fast-moving, and focused on long-term impact over immediate fixes

About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around 4 days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

What does a Senior Post Producer do at WPP Production?

You'll play a central role in delivering high-quality post-production projects across edit, grade, VFX, motion, and sound. As a Senior Post Producer you will bridge hands-on production and leadership, managing key projects, supporting producers, and maintaining strong relationships with clients, agencies, and creative partners. You'll ensure projects run smoothly, budgets are met, and the creative standard remains high across everything that leaves the studio. You'll be someone who thrives on collaboration, solves problems calmly under pressure, and takes pride in delivering work that looks, sounds, and feels exceptional. The ideal candidate will have experience working with a global technology brand or demonstrate a strong drive and ambition to contribute to a high-calibre account. 

Responsibilities

Production

  • Lead multiple post-production projects from brief to final delivery, managing timelines, budgets and workflows.
  • Oversee offline, online, grade, VFX, motion graphics and audio, ensuring projects are delivered on time and to a high standard.
  • Own production workflows, tracking progress, risks and budgets and keeping the Executive Producer informed.
  • Proactively identify and resolve challenges, balancing creative, technical and commercial priorities.
  • Manage global workflows across a centralised production hub and continuously improve ways of working.
  • Explore and implement AI and emerging technologies to improve efficiency, quality and output.

Clients & Collaboration

  • Act as a senior point of contact for clients and agency partners throughout production.
  • Lead client calls, reviews and presentations, building trusted relationships and managing expectations.
  • Collaborate closely with creatives, artists, technical teams and senior production leads to deliver high-quality work.
  • Support and mentor junior and mid-level producers, sharing best practice and fostering a collaborative team environment.

Quality & Commercial

  • Own the studio QC process, ensuring work meets brand, technical and delivery standards.
  • Develop and implement robust QC workflows and best practices.
  • Prepare budgets and estimates, maintaining accurate financial tracking and identifying opportunities to improve efficiency.
  • Contribute to rate cards, templates and processes that strengthen production and commercial performance.

Requirements

  • Strong post-production experience across broadcast, digital and social.
  • Senior-level experience managing complex, high-end campaigns from brief to delivery.
  • Strong understanding of the full post-production pipeline, including edit, colour, online, VFX and audio.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects, priorities and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communicator, confident working with clients, agency partners and internal teams.
  • Experience managing international clients and senior stakeholders across multiple markets.
  • Calm, organised and solutions-focused, with the ability to stay composed under pressure.
  • Collaborative team player who leads by example and supports the development of others.
  • Passionate about craft, creativity, technology and innovation, with a strong eye for detail and efficiency.
  • Genuine interest in technology brands and the wider tech landscape.
  • Flexible and adaptable when project deadlines require occasional evening or weekend support. We value work-life balance and these instances are infrequent, with time off in lieu provided where appropriate.

#LI-LS1

Why work here: 
At WPP Production, you'll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You'll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP's unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

About the team
Security Engineering is a team of five covering cloud security, detection, and security operations. The team runs Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR, and Defender for Cloud, and manages tooling through infrastructure-as-code. They run a quarterly penetration test programme and are continuously building out our detection and response capability. It's a small team with broad scope, which means your work is visible, your opinions are heard, and there are meaningful problems for our engineers to work on.

This is a contract role, so we're looking for someone who can hit the ground running. You'll bring immediate impact and add value from day one, working independently without a long ramp-up. Your work will be visible, and the problems you solve will matter.


Does this sound like you?
You're a senior security engineer who operates credibly across cloud security, detection tooling, and incident response, without being narrowly specialised. You own meaningful parts of the security stack, contribute hands-on to Azure cloud hardening, and show up reliably when incidents need investigating or pen test cycles need coordinating. You're energised by visible impact, your work matters, and your voice is heard.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Own and operate our alerting and monitoring capability through a transition period, keeping detection and response steady.

  • Maintain and improve our Microsoft Sentinel deployment: writing and tuning detection rules, managing data connectors, and reducing alert noise.

  • Operate and optimise Defender XDR and Defender for Cloud, including policy management and posture recommendations.

  • Maintain and extend automated security checks in our delivery pipelines (shift-left).

  • Drive down time-to-fix on known vulnerabilities, coordinating remediation with engineering squads.

  • Support data-loss-prevention controls that reduce the risk of sensitive data leaving the business.

  • Support safeguards around how the business accesses and uses AI, including securing AI workloads and their data exposure.

  • Investigate suspicious activity surfaced through Sentinel and Defender: triage, escalate, or contain as appropriate.

About the Role

Xsolla is looking for a Senior Delivery Manager to help bring greater clarity, coordination, and operational discipline across our product development teams.

The Senior Delivery Manager will own the operating rhythm of the team: maintaining the backlog and roadmap, running engineering ceremonies, surfacing risks and blockers, and ensuring that changes are communicated clearly—not just what is changing, but why.

Beyond day-to-day delivery, this person will also play an important role in identifying broader operational challenges and working with leadership to improve how the team plans, communicates, prioritizes, and executes.

Cross-Functional Alignment

That’s where you come in! Join our global team and help us make great cinema accessible to everyone, everywhere.

About the Role

MUBI has grown spectacularly over the last few years. This has been accompanied by increases in volumes of transactions with the numerous partners that MUBI works with, as well as increased staff expenditures on business activities.

As part of a small team, this Accounts Payable Assistant role within the London-based Finance team will become an expert in handling these areas, and will play a crucial part in helping the team to grow its capabilities in line with MUBI’s long-term business plan.

On a daily basis, the role will involve processing inbound requests from external suppliers and internal colleagues, leading on communications with stakeholders to solve problems, and working closely with other members of the Finance team.

We work hybrid-remote where we require 3 office days in London. Our core days are Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday, with the flexibility to use our offices on the remaining two days if you wish.

Where you’ll have impact:

  • Run the accounts payable transactional processes:

    • Process incoming invoices from suppliers, ensuring these have been approved by budget holders and then entered accurately into the finance system

    • Process staff expense claims and ensuring these are correctly documented, approved in line with policies, and entered in the finance system

    • Manage weekly payment runs to ensure suppliers and employees are paid correctly according to internal policies

    • Match payments to supplier accounts within the finance system, as part of the wider bank reconciliation processes

    • Own inbound accounts payable emails and queries

  • Develop and run existing and new accounts payable control processes:

    • Connecting with your counterparts at our suppliers to reconcile ledger accounts and understand and solve any invoicing discrepancies

    • Suggest and implement improvements to processes for staff expense claims and company credit card expenditures

    • Where tasks are consistent and repeatable, work with others in the team to develop automated processes

  • Contribute to the monthly accounting close process:

    • Maintain monthly prepayments and accruals schedules

    • Identify significant expenses that have not been invoiced, for inclusion in the monthly accruals schedule

What you’ll bring:

  • Experience in a role running regular transactional processes, ideally in a medium- or large-sized company.

  • Attention to detail - a single digit error can be meaningful when it comes to payments.

  • Pride in delivering high quality and proactive ownership of your area of responsibility.

  • Working experience with Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel is essential.

data.description:
We are hiring a Head of Brand to own how Pairs shows up in the world. The brand, the content behind it, the video we put out, and the small team that makes it with you.

Pairs is where founders come to raise capital. We pair them with the right investors from a large, engaged global investor network, then our agents manage the relationships that turn into meetings. It is a two-sided platform, live with paying clients, profitable and self-funded, built by a small, senior, flat team that ships fast.

The role

You own the brand. What Pairs says, where it says it, how it looks, and the image a founder or investor meets before they ever talk to us. You set the strategy and you run it. Most weeks that means one or two high-value posts in the founders' voices and one or two from the company. You run the story shoots with the founders and investors we work with, from booking the guest through to the final cut, and you cut video yourself. There is a weekly newsletter that also lives on our site, a monthly one, and a quarterly report we want the category to quote. Paid comes later, once we turn it on, and you own the brief behind every campaign. You also get a team, VC Content Interns who live in this space, write daily, and grow into full-time seats under you. You report to the co-founders, strategize with them, and get real creative freedom.

This is a player-coach seat and both halves are real. People who stopped writing and editing when they got their first team will not enjoy this. Neither will someone who has never had anyone reporting to them, though we will hear the case.

All of it is aimed at one thing. When a founder or an investor asks ChatGPT, Perplexity or Google how raising capital works and who to raise with, we want Pairs quoted back, and we want what gets quoted to be good.

What you will own

  • Positioning, voice and look, held consistent everywhere from the site to the feed to the newsroom.

  • Weekly founder and company posts on LinkedIn and X, the newsletter on our site, the monthly one, and the quarterly report. You write them and you ship them.

  • Founder and investor story shoots, from booking and prep through shoot day to the edit, with you cutting.

  • Sponsorships and retargeting, planned and measured against inbound.

  • VC Content Interns you brief, edit and grow into full-time hires.

  • Content structured so AI answer engines and journalists quote us, with share of voice tracked and SEO fundamentals underneath.

You are a fit if you

  • Have built and run a brand end to end that we can open: a named brand where you set the voice, made the content, ran the channels, and know the before and after numbers from memory.

  • Still make it yourself. You write the posts, cut the video, direct the shoot. When we ask what you made versus what you briefed, the answer is specific.

  • Have managed makers: a small team, freelancers, or interns, and grown at least one of them into a bigger job.

  • Write at a high bar in a restrained register, and can point at published work longer than a caption.

  • Have run paid for a brand, sponsorships and retargeting included, or owned the brief and the results while someone else ran the hands.

  • Know how AI answer engines and journalists pick what to cite, and have shipped work with that reader in mind. SEO fundamentals are assumed.

  • Can take one piece that outperformed and explain exactly why, and one that flopped and what you changed.

  • Bonus: you already live in the founder and VC corner of the internet, a personal following among founders or investors, podcast or newsletter production, on-camera comfort.

What we offer

Fully remote and async. Your day overlaps with US Eastern time for a few hours, not full US hours, because that is when this audience is online. Meetings batch on Mondays and Thursdays, the rest is deep work. The best AI tooling, paid (Claude Code, Cursor, top models). Direct access to the co-founders, real creative freedom, a film library already on disk, a video team in place, and a team of interns to grow. The brand is yours to build and yours to run.

How to apply: hit apply, which takes you to our short application form. We read every application.
