About ARCHIMED

With offices in Europe, North America and Asia, ARCHIMED is a leading investment firm focused exclusively on healthcare industries. Its mix of operational, medical, scientific and financial expertise allows ARCHIMED to serve as both a strategic and financial partner to healthcare businesses. Prioritized areas of focus include Biopharma Products, Consumer Health, Healthcare IT, In Vitro Diagnostics, Life Science Tools and Biologic Services, MedTech, and Pharma Services.

ARCHIMED helps partners internationalize, acquire, innovate and expand their products and services. ARCHIMED manages €8 billion across its various funds, including the largest healthcare-only private equity fund raised by a European-based General Partner. Since inception, ARCHIMED has been a committed Impact investor, both directly and through its EURÊKA Foundation.

The Team

  • An international team (with more than 38 nationalities) with complementary education and experience in investment, medical, scientific, strategic and operational sectors
  • Composed of alumni from: INSEAD, Berkeley, Georgetown, Bocconi, HEC Paris, Ponts et Chaussées, ESSEC, Imperial College, Dartmouth, etc.
  • Professional backgrounds: Private Equity, Consulting (A.T. Kearney, Bain, McKinsey), MandA (Lazard, EY, KPMG, PwC), Industry

Requirements

Location: Lyon, France

Contract: Permanent (CDI)

As part of ARCHIMED's Information Systems Department (ISD), reporting directly to our Data/AI Manager, you will drive the development and deployment of Artificial Intelligence solutions across the firm. Acting as the bridge between technical teams, business stakeholders, and the Data/AI leadership, you will ensure that AI initiatives are delivered with strategic alignment, operational rigor, and measurable impact.

Key Responsibilities

1.       Product Development and Strategic Alignment

·       Collaborate on defining the product vision and roadmap for AI initiatives, in close alignment with firm priorities.

·       Translate & challenge business needs into clear, actionable product requirements and user stories

·       Ensure AI solutions deliver measurable value and are adopted effectively across business lines

 

2.        Backlog Management

·       Own, prioritize and continuously refine the product backlog in collaboration with business & development teams

·       Ensure delivery cadence is maintained and risks are proactively escalated

3.        Business Partnering and Change Management

·       Act as the primary point of contact for business stakeholders, gathering needs, managing expectations and driving adoption

·       Support business teams in understanding AI capabilities and in defining use cases with high ROI potential

·       Lead change management efforts to ensure smooth integration of AI tools into existing workflows

·       Manage & develop support materials

 

4.       AI Expertise and Innovation

·       Maintain an up-to-date knowledge of AI/ML trends, tools and best practices relevant to company’s needs

·       Evaluate new AI solutions and vendors, providing informed recommendations to the ISD leadership

·       Ensure responsible AI principles (explainability, fairness, data privacy …) throughout product development & usage

 

5.       Coordination and Governance

·       Coordinate cross-functional teams (Compliance, Cyber, Business) to ensure end-to-end delivery

·       Define and monitor KPIs to track product performance and adoption

·       Contribute to AI governance frameworks, documentation standards and reporting to senior stakeholders

 

 

 

Profile and Qualifications

·       Education: Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Business or a related field

·       Experience: Minimum 5 years as a Product Owner or Product Manager, with at least one significant AI or data-driven product deployment

·       Solid understanding of AI, data pipelines and modern development methodologies  & technologies

·       Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into business language and vice versa

·       Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience working across technical and non-technical teams

·       Analytical mindset with a structured, problem-solving approach

·       Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English (French is a plus)

·       Experience in financial services, private equity or healthcare is a plus

Nice To Have

  • Active Directory

Why you will love working with us

Biggie est un groupe de conseil en communication, né de la fusion de l’agence média Repeat, du trading desk Gamned!, du studio de création vidéo Kazam et de l’agence en stratégie d’influence Beastly.
 
Comprenant 300 collaborateurs et des filiales dans de nombreux pays (France, Belgique, Suisse, Italie, République Tchèque, Emirats Arabes Unis, Brésil…), le groupe s’appuie sur sa capacité à fédérer l’excellence, via l’intégration d’expertises publicitaires leader de leur marché, de manière à concevoir et piloter des stratégies de communication 360 à l'échelle l’internationale.

🗒️ Missions

1. Audit & Optimisation Salesforce

  • Réaliser un audit complet de l’environnement Salesforce : architecture, configuration, automatisations, données, sécurité, reporting et usages.
  • Identifier les dysfonctionnements, risques, points de friction et opportunités d’amélioration.
  • Évaluer l’adéquation de Salesforce avec les processus et besoins métiers.
  • Formuler des recommandations fonctionnelles et techniques et identifier les quick wins.

2. Data, Reporting & Performance

  • Auditer la qualité, la cohérence et la fiabilité des données Salesforce.
  • Analyser les reportings, dashboards et KPIs existants et leur adéquation avec les besoins métiers et de pilotage.
  • Identifier les améliorations nécessaires en matière de data quality, reporting et exploitation des données.

3. Business Analysis & Évolutions

  • Recueillir et formaliser les besoins des utilisateurs et des équipes métiers.
  • Identifier les opportunités d’optimisation des processus et des usages Salesforce.
  • Prioriser les évolutions en fonction de leur valeur métier et de leur complexité.
  • Cadrer les évolutions et assurer leur recette fonctionnelle.

4. Coordination IT & Cabinet Salesforce

  • Être l’interlocuteur référent Salesforce auprès des équipes métiers, de l’IT et du cabinet partenaire.
  • Piloter et coordonner les demandes et projets d’évolution avec le cabinet Salesforce.
  • Challenger les recommandations et solutions proposées par le cabinet.
  • Assurer le suivi des développements, des recettes et des mises en production.
  • Garantir la cohérence globale des évolutions avec les besoins métiers, l’architecture et les contraintes IT.

5. Roadmap & Recommandations

  • Construire une roadmap Salesforce à court, moyen et long terme.
  • Prioriser les actions et évolutions à mener.
  • Assurer un rôle de conseil et d’expertise auprès des équipes internes afin de maximiser la valeur et l’utilisation de Salesforce.

 

👉 Profil recherché

  • Solide expérience en audit, optimisation et évolution de Salesforce

  • Profil à la fois fonctionnel et technique

  • Bonne compréhension des enjeux métiers, data et processus

  • Capacité à challenger l’existant et être force de proposition

  • Forte autonomie et capacité à structurer une roadmap

  • Expérience dans la coordination avec les équipes IT et un cabinet Salesforce

  • Capacité à piloter les évolutions, développements et recettes

  • Excellentes qualités de communication et de gestion des parties prenantes

🎁 Nos avantages: 
 
• Un groupe international présent dans le monde entier
• Des entités pluridisciplinaires expertes dans leur domaine : programmatique, influence, RP, 360, création de contenus… 
• Possibilité de mobilité interne au sein des différentes entités du groupe
• De la formation continue avec une Digital Academy 
• Un accès à la plateforme HappyPal qui vous donnera accès à des réductions sur de nombreuses marques et loisirs (cinémas, concerts, parcs d’attractions, musées…)
• Des cours de sports quotidiens dans nos locaux : pilates, cross training
• Un forfait mobilité durable qui vous permet de louer un vélo auprès de notre partenaire BeeToGreen ou de vous faire rembourser à hauteur de 45€/mois votre location de vélo

Qui sommes-nous ?

N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers. Avec plus de 20 000 clients et 1 million d’utilisateurs dans 98 pays, notre solution N2F s’impose comme une référence sur le marché français.

N2F est une plateforme complète de Spend Management (notes de frais, cartes corporate, factures fournisseurs, budget), conçue pour simplifier le quotidien des entreprises grâce à une expérience fluide, intuitive et 100 % connectée (web et mobile).

Portés par une équipe engagée, qui place l’humain au centre de ses priorités, nous poursuivons une ambition claire : devenir le leader européen de la gestion des dépenses professionnelles.

Pour accompagner cette croissance, nous recherchons un(e) Product Manager confirmé(e) pour rejoindre notre équipe Produit et prendre la responsabilité d’un domaine fonctionnel clé de notre plateforme. Le terrain de jeu est vaste et les défis nombreux : internationalisation, intelligence artificielle, agents, automatisation des workflows, interconnectivité, refonte fonctionnelle et amélioration continue de l’expérience utilisateur.

Tes principales missions :

Rattaché(e) à la VP Product, tu seras responsable d’un domaine fonctionnel de notre plateforme et de son évolution à long terme.

Stratégie de Produit :

  • Définir et porter la vision de ton domaine produit.

  • Comprendre en profondeur les besoins des clients, des utilisateurs et des équipes internes.

  • Analyser les tendances du marché, la concurrence et les évolutions technologiques afin d’identifier les meilleures opportunités de développement.

  • Participer à l’identification et à l’évaluation de nouveaux cas d’usage liés à l’IA, à l’automatisation et aux agents.

Gestion du Cycle de Vie du Produit :

  • Construire et piloter la roadmap de ton périmètre.

  • Identifier, qualifier et prioriser les opportunités en fonction de leur impact utilisateur et business.

  • Superviser le cycle de vie complet des fonctionnalités, de la discovery au lancement avec le Product marketing.

  • Mesurer les résultats et ajuster les orientations en fonction des retours terrain et des données.

Développement de Produit :

  • Piloter la conception et le développement de nouvelles fonctionnalités avec les équipes Product Design et Engineering.

  • Garantir une expérience utilisateur simple, intuitive et performante.

  • Valider les solutions proposées grâce à des tests utilisateurs, des analyses de données et des expérimentations.

  • Veiller à délivrer des solutions pragmatiques, robustes et créatrices de valeur.

Le travail collaboratif est au cœur du rôle :

  • Travailler étroitement avec les équipes Sales, Customer Success et Support afin de comprendre les enjeux clients.

  • Communiquer régulièrement avec les parties prenantes internes et externes.

  • Favoriser l’alignement autour des priorités produit.

  • Participer à la promotion du produit en interne et en externe.

  • Contribuer à la diffusion de la culture Produit au sein de l’entreprise.


Ce que l’on va attendre de toi :

  • Tu disposes d’au moins 4 ans d’expérience en tant que Product Manager, idéalement dans un environnement SaaS B2B.

  • Tu sais appréhender des problématiques métier complexes et les transformer en solutions simples et efficaces.

  • Tu maîtrises les méthodologies agiles et les bonnes pratiques Produit.

  • Tu es capable de piloter un sujet en autonomie et d’embarquer les équipes autour de tes projets.

  • Tu sais arbitrer, prioriser et faire des choix pragmatiques et orientés impact.

  • Tu as déjà mené des projets d’envergure impliquant plusieurs parties prenantes.

  • Tu possèdes d’excellentes compétences en communication et en collaboration.

  • Tu es curieux(se), rigoureux(se) et tu cherches à comprendre les sujets en profondeur avant de prendre des décisions.

  • Tu disposes d’un esprit analytique fort tout en gardant une forte orientation utilisateur.

TL;DR: We’re looking for a hands-on Talent Lead to own and build our hiring function from scratch. You’ll personally drive hiring across the company, build scalable recruiting processes, track hiring performance, and work closely with the Head of People and hiring managers across GTM, Ops, Research, and Product.

 

About us

White Circle is an AI Safety company building the safety, reliability, and optimization layer for AI systems. At the core of our platform are policies – simple natural-language rules that define what an AI model should and shouldn’t do. We automatically test, enforce, and continuously improve these policies at scale.

  • We’ve raised $11M from top funds, founders, and senior leaders at OpenAI, Anthropic, HuggingFace, Mistral, DeepMind, Datadog, Sentry, and others

  • We process over one hundred million API calls every month

  • We fine-tune and train our own LLMs so they run faster and cheaper than any open or proprietary model

We’re a small, highly focused team. If you want to work deeply on hard problems, see your work ship to production quickly, and influence how AI safety is actually built – you’re the one we need.

 

You will:

  • Own and run the hiring process end-to-end (sourcing, screening, interviews, and closing)

  • Personally source and hire candidates across the company (this is a hands-on recruiting role)

  • Build our hiring processes and infrastructure from scratch, including interview loops, scorecards, pipelines, and candidate tracking

  • Work closely with hiring managers to define roles, hiring priorities, and candidate profiles

  • Drive hiring across a wide range of functions, including GTM, Ops, Research, Product, and Engineering

  • Lead international hiring across the US, EU, UK, and other markets as we expand

  • Build and maintain hiring metrics and reporting, including pipeline conversion, time to hire, source performance, and offer acceptance

  • Use hiring data to identify bottlenecks and continuously improve the recruiting process

  • Build and maintain strong sourcing channels across different functions and geographies

  • Develop a strong candidate experience and represent White Circle throughout the hiring process

  • Help define and improve our approach to hiring, including how we assess candidates and make hiring decisions

  • Partner with leadership on long-term talent planning and hiring strategy

 

You’ll fit right in if you:

  • Have several years of experience running hiring at a startup, ideally in an early-stage or high-growth environment

  • Have personally hired a meaningful number of people and are comfortable owning the full recruiting process yourself

  • Have built hiring processes and recruiting operations from scratch

  • Have experience hiring across multiple functions, including GTM, Operations, Research, Product, and Engineering

  • Have experience with international hiring across multiple countries and markets

  • Are comfortable working directly with leadership and senior hiring managers

  • Are highly data-driven and comfortable tracking and analysing recruiting metrics

  • Are an excellent sourcer and know how to find strong candidates beyond simply posting jobs

  • Communicate clearly and build strong relationships with both candidates and hiring managers

  • Are comfortable operating independently in an environment where processes are still being built

  • Speak and write fluent English (C1+)

A big plus:

  • Experience hiring for AI, ML, and Research roles

  • Experience building a recruiting function as the first or one of the first talent hires

  • Experience hiring in the US, EU, and UK

  • Experience with employer branding and building a strong talent pipeline

  • Experience using AI tools to improve sourcing, screening, research, or recruiting ops

 

Why White Circle

  • Meaningful equity package

  • Paid time off in line with your local regulations, no matter where you work from

  • All the hardware, tools, and services you need

  • Covered subscriptions for AI agents

  • Team off-sites twice a year: we’ve recently been to the Alps, Saint-Tropez, and Mabella

 

How we hire

  1. Introductory call with Head of People (25 min)

  2. Practical Recruitment Exercise with Head of People (60 min)

  3. Final conversation with our CEO (45 min)

Please submit your application in English.

data.description:
The AI Enablement Team is the catalyst for internal transformation and product acceleration across Actian. In the modern data landscape, AI is not a siloed experimental lab; it is a core capability that must be embedded into our product DNA and our engineering workflows.

We are looking for an AI Enablement Lead who will architect, scale, and own our AI enablement strategy end-to-end. You are not a theoretical researcher or a passive prompt engineer; you are a highly practical, technical driver who builds the foundational platforms, tooling, and frameworks that allow other product and engineering teams to deploy AI safely, rapidly, and at scale. You will democratize AI across the organization, establish modern LLMOps/MLOps practices, and directly impact the Actian Data Intelligence Platform by introducing agentic workflows, intelligent data pipelines, and cutting-edge capabilities.

⚖️ Who are we

Plato is building the AI OS for litigation lawyers.

With AI, the legal industry is on the verge of a major transformation. Litigation lawyers are overwhelmed by complex and repetitive tasks: complex damage calculations, thousands of documents to review, days spent drafting legal documents, and more.

Our mission: Build the leading AI OS for litigation lawyers, enabling professionals to work 5x faster, by putting their whole firm on autopilot.

Plato already supports more than 30 law firms and 1 major insurance company’s legal team, who use our solution daily to manage hundreds of active cases.

Founded in January 2026 by Ben (CEO) and Alexandre (CTO), we are backed by Hexa (formerly eFounders), Europe’s leading startup studio. Hexa has launched over 35 companies, including unicorns such as Front, Aircall, and Spendesk, collectively generating more than €230M in ARR and raising over €750M in funding.

Plato is live with real users, real data and real revenue, solving concrete legal workflows in production. We’re now looking for a Founding AI Engineer to help us turn the latest advances in AI into reliable products used every day by legal professionals.

🎯 Your mission

You’ll work directly with Alexandre , our CTO, at the intersection of AI, software engineering and product.

Your job is not to do AI research for the sake of research. You’ll experiment with models and approaches, understand what works, and turn the best solutions into reliable production systems.

You'll work on problems such as building agentic workflows, making sense complex legal documents, designing autonomous long-running agents, and improving the quality and reliability of AI-generated outputs.

Responsibilities

Build AI-powered product features

  • Design and ship AI features used directly by lawyers

  • Be at the bleeing edge of the agentic stack: memory, sandboxes, code mode, lots of tools, subagents…

  • Turn prototypes and experiments into production-ready feature

Work with complex data

  • Extract, structure and reason over large volumes of unstructured legal documents

  • Build robust data and document-processing pipelines

  • Experiment with different models and approaches to improve accuracy and reliability

Make AI work in production

  • Evaluate and improve agent outcomes through testing, evals and iteration

  • Optimize systems for quality, latency and cost

  • Build the backend services and infrastructure needed to run AI reliably at scale

Shape the product

  • Work directly with the founders and users to understand real-world problems

  • Move quickly from problem → experiment → production (think days, not weeks)

  • Take ownership of your projects from exploration to deployment

🤩 This role is for you if

We're looking for a strong software or AI engineer with 2+ years of experience who wants to build real-world AI products at the forefront of the agentic stack.

You like working close to founders and users, making pragmatic technical decisions, and shipping software that actually runs in production.

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Have a strong software engineering foundation, ideally with Typescript and experience shipping production systems

  • Have experience with agents and/or evals and frameworks like Mastra, Eve, Pydantic, Langchain, etc…

  • Can take an AI problem from experimentation to production

  • Enjoy solving problems with no clear solution

  • Have a strong product mindset and care about user impact

  • Are autonomous and pragmatic, comfortable navigating early-stage ambiguity and shipping fast

⚙️ Our tech stack

Our stack is designed to support AI-first workflows and production reliability.

  • Backend & Frontend: TypeScript, Node.js, React, tRPC

  • Infrastructure: AWS (Terraform)

  • Data & AI: Mastra, Bedrock

  • Database: Postgres

You don't need to master every tool — what matters is your ability to design robust systems, learn fast, and make sound technical trade-offs.

💎 What we offer

  • Build alongside a strong AI expert: Work closely with Alexandre, our CTO, who has deep expertise in AI agents, and turn cutting-edge AI into production systems.

Plato is committed to creating a diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment irrespective of gender, origin, identity, background and sexual orientation.

At Brevo, we’re not just building a CRM. With our technology, we’re helping millions of organizations build lasting relationships with their customers.

From emails and SMS to WhatsApp, Chat, and Marketing Automation, our tools are intuitive, powerful, and built to scale with every ambition. We give businesses a clear view of the customer journey, so they can focus on what matters: connection.

As a certified B Corp, we’re proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance.

Today, more than 500,000 businesses across 180 countries—from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin—trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. Our reliable technology and 75+ integrations help them create unparalleled customer experiences, without the usual tech headaches.

We recently exceeded 200m ARR and reached a major milestone by becoming a Unicorn, backed by strong growth and global expansion - and we’re just getting started!

The role:
 

Join us as a Product Engineer to build a new product within Brevo called Brevo OS.

Brevo OS is a startup inside Brevo: a team of six, a product we started from an empty repository earlier this year, and the feel of a small company within the big one. The product works, the first customer deployments are beginning, and a great deal is still undecided — so the people who join us now will shape what it becomes.
It's an AI-native operating system for small businesses: a system of agents that helps a solopreneur, a hair salon or a building contractor run their whole business — clients, contracts and signature, invoicing, their website, their inbox. Modules get added the way an ERP grows, except the whole thing is built around agents from the ground up.


Your Impact at Brevo:
  • Turn a very high level business need into something real : understand the function, define the users, the smallest useful version, the entities and their lifecycles, the permissions and constraints that matter, and what to build versus integrate
  • Decide which of our platform primitives to extend rather than reinvent, then build it, ship it, watch it in production, and improve it
  • Work across product management, frontend, backend, data modelling, infrastructure, and AI. Everyone arrived with a specialism and nobody is confined to theirs; product thinking and business analysis is part of everyone’s job
  • Build almost entirely through coding agents: Claude Code is the workflow, not a pilot running alongside it, for implementation, codebase exploration, documentation, debugging, and operations
  • Decompose problems into work an agent can actually execute, give it context without over-constraining it, and tell the difference between correct and merely plausible
  • Verify with tests and instrumentation, not vibes, and keep a large generated codebase coherent
  • Work day to day in TypeScript, Kubernetes, and agentic frameworks

    • Who you are:
  • Around 2-5 years of professional engineering experience. We care more about your slope than your years.
  • Real depth in something, and no attachment to staying there. Bring what you're genuinely strong at — the team compounds those — and expect to spend a good part of your time well outside it.
  • Coding agents already central to how you work. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, something equivalent. Not "I've generated the Unit Tests" — real delegation of substantial work, and real review of what comes back. Scepticism about generated output is a feature of this job, not a problem.
  • Evidence you've owned a problem, not just implemented a ticket — something you helped define, drove, shipped and then lived with in production. Product questions are your questions too.
  • At your best when the brief is one sentence and the plan is still moving. We're learning what this product is, so priorities change often. The mission doesn't.
  • English. We're an international team working across France and India, and English is our working language. French is not required.
    • If you don't meet all the requirements above but believe this opportunity matches your expectations and experience, we still encourage you to apply!

  • A place to grow, together: Join an international team in a bright, collaborative office located in a vibrant neighbourhood.

Wanna join the adventure?

Loft Orbital flies other people's payloads and software on standardized satellites, and we are building the first marketplace for space-based AI applications: the store where partners publish, deploy, and monetize AI solutions that run on satellites in orbit. We are hiring the founding developer of that marketplace. You will work directly with the Director of Marketplace to take the platform from MVP to the system behind dozens of partner solutions, on a small team where you own features end-to-end and ship weekly.

About this role:
  • Build the Marketplace storefront, partner portal, and admin tooling.
  • Design and implement the APIs and services behind them: catalog, onboarding, entitlements, and metering.
  • Integrate with our mission platform for authentication, workflow triggers, and solution deployment in close collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Build connectors for third-party constellations and data providers.
  • Own quality: tests, CI/CD, monitoring.

Must Haves:
  • 4+ years building and shipping full-stack products.
  • Experience with Sprint development.
  • Strong TypeScript/React on the front end and solid backend experience in Python, Go, or Node.
  • Cloud-native by default (we run on GCP): containers/kubernetes, managed services, infrastructure as code.
  • Comfortable with API design, OAuth, and multi-tenant authorization.
  • Fluent with AI-assisted development workflows and expected to use them.
  • You have shipped a zero-to-one product, ideally a marketplace, developer platform, or SaaS portal, and you like small teams with large scope.

Nice to Haves:
  • Billing integrations (Stripe or similar).
  • Geospatial or earth observation exposure.
  • Security-minded engineering (tenant isolation, audit trails).
  • Experience in the architecture of modern systems.

Some of Our Awesome Benefits:
  • Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success
  • Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best
  • Health and life insurance, we care about your health
  • Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! (we even have a slack channel about it #loft-gourmand)
  • Cross-office travel opportunities between San Francisco, Colorado, and Toulouse to learn from our differences

At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions.  We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes.

    Who We Are

    Loft: Space Made Simple. 

    Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit.

    We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

About the job

Lead the design, development, and adoption of AI systems within a strategic business domain.

You will combine deep AI engineering expertise with product and business understanding to identify high-impact opportunities, define roadmaps, and deliver measurable outcomes.

As the AI technical lead for your domain, you will drive architecture decisions, engineering excellence, and AI adoption across teams and stakeholders. Examples of domains include: Sales, GTM and Marketing or Finance & Legal

This is a permanent position (CDI) based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 4 days on-site per week.

Annual gross salary range (package): €90,000 – €100,000

This range is provided for transparency purposes and reflects our internal compensation grid for this role level. The final offer will be determined based on your experience, skills, and the scope of responsibilities involved.

 

Why Now, Why Mirakl

Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis.

At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption.

We are looking for a Principal AI Engineer to transform cutting-edge AI technologies into reliable, scalable, and measurable products used by leading enterprises worldwide.

You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it.


What You'll Do

1. Own Tech Strategy for Your Domain

  • Identify high-value opportunities with Business leaders
  • Define the Tech vision and own the agent product roadmap for your domain

2. Lead AI System Development

  • Design and build production-grade AI systems
  • Drive architecture decisions
  • Ensure scalability, reliability, and maintainability

3. Drive Adoption & Business Impact

  • Work closely with end users
  • Measure adoption and outcomes
  • Accelerate AI transformation across your domain

4. Establish Technical Excellence

  • Promote best practices for evaluation, testing, guardrails, and observability
  • Review designs and mentor engineers
  • Raise the quality bar across initiatives

5. Grow AI Capability

  • Mentor AI Engineers and Agent Builders
  • Share knowledge and reusable components
  • Build AI expertise within your organization

Success Metrics

  • Business impact delivered by AI initiatives
  • Adoption within the domain
  • Technical quality and reliability
  • Team capability growth

 

Our stack and tools

  • Languages: Python and SQL
  • AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models
  • Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases
  • Infrastructure: AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes

 

You'll Love This Job If you have 

  • 7+ years in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, or Applied AI
  • Strong experience with LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, evaluation, and production systems
  • Ability to influence Product and Business decisions
  • Proven leadership on complex cross-functional initiatives

Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can understand what you have worked on!

Want to join us? Here is our process 

  • A 30-40 min phone conversation with one of our Tech recruiters. This will be an opportunity to discuss your background, expectations, and discover what Mirakl can offer you in return.
  • An initial 1 hour technical discussion with a member of the Data Science team and Engineering Team, which will allow you to delve into the more specific aspects of your expertise and discover how your skills can be integrated into our projects.
  • 2 x 45-minute "STAR" interviews with future Mirakl colleagues to discuss our values and company culture.

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews.

About this role

We are seeking an experienced Director of Revenue Operations to own and scale a critical function across Europe. While systems exist, there is no dedicated leader. You will drive end-to-end revenue infrastructure and reporting directly to the CBO. You'll have budget flexibility for tools and resources, and the autonomy to shape how the function evolves.

What you will do

  • Map our growth strategy. Design segmentation by customer size and vertical, and define territory models for BENELUX, DACH, and new markets.

  • Plan for scale. Lead quarterly planning cycles: set regional quotas, define sales capacity targets, and align capacity models to pipeline and ARR goals.

planqc builds neutral atom quantum computers in Garching. Behind every experiment and every line of control software sits an IT setup that has to work: laptops that are ready on day one, accounts that exist when someone starts, and hardware that is where it should be.
As a Working Student in IT Support & Systems, you will be the first point of contact for colleagues who need IT help. You handle 1st level support, prepare and hand over equipment, and keep our Microsoft 365 environment and IT documentation in order. You also support onboarding and offboarding from the IT side, so new colleagues can start working immediately.
This role suits a student who wants real hands on experience with infrastructure and admin tools, and who enjoys helping people as much as fixing systems.


Your responsibilities

  • Provide 1st level IT support for employees and troubleshoot common hardware, software and access issues
  • Support hardware procurement: ordering, tracking and preparing laptops, monitors and accessories
  • Manage the equipment lifecycle, from setup for new starters to collection and reset for leavers
  • Support IT onboarding and offboarding, including accounts, access, devices and the welcome setup
  • Handle day to day Microsoft 365 tasks such as mailboxes, distribution lists and Teams/SharePoint access
  • Keep IT documentation accurate and up to date, including guides, inventory lists and onboarding checklists
  • Work with your IT colleagues on more complex issues and escalate when needed


What you bring

  • Enrolled in an IT related degree program such as Computer Science or Information Systems, any semester
  • Genuine interest in IT and in how systems and infrastructure work
  • Basic computer literacy with Windows or macOS and solid troubleshooting instincts
  • Ability to pick up new tools quickly and to ask questions when something is unclear

Nice to have

  • Hobby level experience with Windows or macOS troubleshooting, home networking or similar
  • Basic familiarity with Microsoft 365 tools such as Outlook, SharePoint and Teams
  • Interest in growing into a junior or full System Administrator role over time


What characterizes you

  • You are curious and eager to learn. You do not need to know everything on day one
  • You are friendly and patient when helping colleagues who are less confident with technology

Why join planqc

At planqc, you will work on one of the most promising quantum computing architectures alongside a highly driven and collaborative team spanning physics, engineering, and software.
We combine deep-tech research with an engineering mindset, turning scientific breakthroughs into scalable quantum systems.
Joining us means:

If you're excited about keeping the people and systems of a quantum computing company running while you study, we'd love to hear from you.

Eigeninitiative, technischer Weitblick und die Freude daran, gemeinsam Lösungen zu entwickeln, sind uns genauso wichtig wie ein respektvoller und wertschätzender Umgang im Team.

  • Agentic Engineering: Entwurf und Umsetzung agentischer Systeme – Tool- und Function-Calling, Orchestrierung mehrstufiger Workflows, Kontext- und State-Management, Retries und Fallbacks, Human-in-the-Loop und sinnvolle Guardrails
  • Design und Umsetzung von LLM-Anwendungen: RAG-Pipelines, strukturierte Extraktion, Evaluation, Observability

  • Technologische Beratung unserer Kunden bei Architektur-, Technologie- und Make-or-Buy-Entscheidungen

Dein Profil

Wir verstehen uns als starker IT-Partner für den deutschen Mittelstand und bieten unseren Kunden ganzheitliche Lösungen entlang der gesamten IT-Wertschöpfungskette: von Managed Services über Cloud-Infrastruktur bis hin zu IT-Security.

Was uns antreibt? Der Anspruch, mittelständische Unternehmen mit maßgeschneiderter, zuverlässiger IT pragmatisch und partnerschaftlich nach vorne zu bringen.


Dein Wirkungsfeld

Wenn die GBC Group eine Gesellschaft übernimmt, beginnt die eigentliche Arbeit erst danach: Strukturen zusammenführen, Standards etablieren, Führung, Ergebnisse sichtbar machen. METYCLE: where innovation meets sustainability
We are reshaping the global secondary metals industry to accelerate the circular flow of metals. And the impact is significant: recycling aluminium can reduce greenhouse gas emissions by up to 95% compared with primary aluminium production.
And we take it further! Our SmartSorting Hubs combine advanced sorting technology, automation and AI to transform how complex scrap is processed, turning selected mixed streams into better-defined industrial feedstock while improving material quality and traceability.Join us at a defining stage as we bring the $600 billion scrap metals industry into the 21st century and build a new global standard for secondary metals.


READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT?

We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst who turns complex operational and business data into clear insights, better decisions, and measurable improvements. You bring strong hands-on experience in data analysis, SQL, visualisation, and working with large and imperfect datasets - and understand how to connect data to real-world processes and business outcomes.
This is an integrated role at the intersection of business, operations, and technology. You’ll work directly with teams to understand their data needs, dig into the details hands-on, and find the right way to answer their questions - whether through SQL, Excel, dashboards, or other tools. You’ll also translate recurring needs into requirements for Engineering and help build stable, automated reporting and analytics over time, particularly across our trading business.
Join our international team and play a key role in shaping innovative solutions for scrap metal processing - using data and technology to build a more efficient and sustainable future.


YOUR MISSION

  • Analytics & Insights: Turn complex business questions into clear, actionable analysis, identifying trends, opportunities, risks, and the key drivers behind business performance. Work directly with the people who have the data need to understand their questions, challenge assumptions, and turn raw data into meaningful insights and decisions.

data.description:
ABOUT US

METYCLE - where innovation meets sustainability

We are building the B2B online platform to accelerate the global circular flow of secondary metals. By connecting buyers and sellers of scrap metal globally, we enable efficient trade of secondary metals and drive the seamless flow of recycling material, essential for reducing CO2 emissions by up to 95% compared to primary metal production.

And we take it further! We are pioneering an innovative Smart Sorting Facility that leverages AI, machine learning, and robotics to transform how scrap metal is processed, enhance material quality, improve traceability, and drive the recycling industry into the digital era.

Join us at the early stage in bringing the $610 billion scrap metal trading industry into the 21st century and in shaping the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions.


READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT?

If you are passionate about industrial automation, solving complex technical challenges, and building something from the ground up, join our team as an Industrial Automation Engineer.

The machinery is the easy part to buy. The control system that turns it into a plant - and the standards, documentation, and data that keep it running - is what we are hiring you to own.

We are looking for an experienced Industrial Automation Engineer to take ownership of our plant’s control systems from design through commissioning and into stable production. You bring deep hands-on experience in programming and commissioning industrial control systems and are comfortable taking responsibility for the PLC, safety systems, HMI, industrial networking, and interfaces between multiple machine suppliers.

Beyond programming, you understand what it takes to make a plant genuinely reliable in production and have the technical confidence to hold suppliers to high professional standards. Join our international team, help build innovative solutions for scrap metal processing, and contribute to a more sustainable future.


YOUR MISSION

  • PLC & Plant Control: Design, write, and own the PLC program using Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500, including control logic, sequencing, fault handling, and HMI
  • Commissioning & Production: Take the plant from design through commissioning to a stable, running line, owning the full journey through FAT/SAT and the hands-on work required to make the plant genuinely reliable
  • Plant Availability: Design stop and interlock behaviour to minimise unnecessary downtime — allowing unaffected parts of the plant to keep running when it is safe to do so. Plant availability is a direct business outcome here, and you will directly influence it
  • Machine Safety: Implement the machine-safety control concept on a fail-safe F-CPU with F-I/O, including the hardwired e-stop loop, PLC-enforced zone isolation that cannot be overridden, guard interlocks, and controlled, sequenced shutdown
  • Safety & Compliance: Be our in-house technical counterpart on EN ISO 13849 performance-level determination and the CE file, working with external assessors while retaining ownership of the technical approach and decisions
  • Machine Integration: Integrate control systems from several different machine suppliers into one coherent line, so that a single stop is genuinely a single stop across the whole plant
  • Supplier Management: Hold machine builders and panel builders to specification, including unlocked code, complete documentation, and standards compliance
  • OT / IT & Industrial IoT: Get plant data out over OPC UA / MQTT / Modbus TCP into our own systems, so stoppage reasons, energy use, and throughput become actionable data. Work closely with our Industrial IoT team, who own the edge and data side of that boundary


YOUR PROFILE

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience programming and commissioning industrial control systems, with a track record of bringing production equipment or complete lines into stable operation
  • Deep Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500 experience, with strong skills in SCL, LAD/FBD, HMI/SCADA, industrial networking (PROFINET, PROFIBUS, Modbus TCP), drives/VFDs, and fault-finding
  • Strong machine safety competence, including F-CPU / Safety Integrated and EN ISO 13849, with the ability to explain and defend performance-level determinations
  • Comfortable reading electrical schematics and troubleshooting cabinets, hardware, signals, wiring, and control behaviour directly on the shop floor. You have brought at least one production line from commissioning into stable production; maintenance-only experience is not sufficient
  • Experience working with machine and panel builders, with the confidence to hold suppliers accountable for code quality, documentation, standards compliance, and professional delivery
  • Experience with brownfield projects and legacy migration (STEP 7 Classic → TIA); experience in bulk material handling, recycling, sorting, or minerals processing is a plus

Ob in den Kommentaren unserer Social-Media-Kanäle oder in Bewertungen auf Trustpilot und Google – überall dort entsteht ein Stück öffentliches Bild von 1KOMMA5°. Damit wir dort schnell, passend und im Sinne unserer Marke reagieren, suchen wir dich als Verstärkung für unser Community- und Bewertungsmanagement – mit Gespür für Sprache, Plattformen und den Menschen dahinter.

Community Management & Bewertungsmanagement (dein Hauptfokus)

  • Du unterstützt das Team bei der Community-Betreuung auf Instagram, Facebook, YouTube und LinkedIn in der zeitnahen Beantwortung von Kommentaren und Nachrichten im Ton von 1KOMMA5°
  • Du unterstützt im operativen Bewertungsmanagement: Du screenst neue Bewertungen auf Trustpilot und Google, reportest Auffälligkeiten und hilfst bei der Implementierung entsprechender Maßnahmen
  • Du behältst wöchentlich das relevante Video-Umfeld auf YouTube im Blick, sichtest ausgewählte Kanäle und Beiträge rund um 1KOMMA5° und gibst deine Beobachtungen strukturiert ans Team weiter, damit bei Bedarf schnell die richtigen nächsten Schritte eingeleitet werden können
  • Du unterstüzt unsere Organic Traffic Machine: Direkt nachdem neue Inhalte auf unseren Kanälen live gehen, gehst du aktiv in die Kommentare unserer eigenen Posts, stößt Diskussionen an und sorgst so mit dafür, dass unsere Inhalte zusätzlich an Reichweite und Sichtbarkeit gewinnen
  • Du behältst die Logiken der einzelnen Plattformen im Blick – was auf LinkedIn funktioniert, funktioniert nicht automatisch auf Instagram – und kommunizierst dabei immer im Sinne von 1KOMMA5°
  • Du platzierst unsere Inhalte auch dort, wo sich Gespräche über Energiewende, PV, Wärmepumpen & Co. sowieso schon abspielen – zum Beispiel durch passende, wertstiftende Kommentare auf anderen Accounts

Dein Signature-Projekt: GEO

  • Du übernimmst bei uns das Thema GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) als eigenes kleines Projekt und bringst dich inhaltlich aktiv ein: Du entwickelst mit, wie unsere Social-Media- und Community-Inhalte so formuliert und aufbereitet werden, dass sie auch in KI-gestützten Suchergebnissen und Antworten gut sichtbar sind
  • Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, testest neue Formulierungsansätze und hilfst dabei, GEO nach und nach fest in unsere Content-Erstellung einzubauen

Dein Profil

  • Du bist noch mindestens zwei Semester an einer deutschen Hochschule im Bereich Marketing, Kommunikation, Medien, BW L oder in einem vergleichbaren Studiengang immatrikuliert
  • Du bist selbst viel auf Social Media unterwegs und verstehst intuitiv, wie sich Instagram, Facebook, YouTube und LinkedIn jeweils unterscheiden – in Ton, Format und Zielgruppe
  • Erste Erfahrung im Community- oder Social-Media-Management ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss – wichtiger ist uns dein Gespür für Sprache und Menschen.
  • Du schreibst sicher und stilsicher auf Deutsch, Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil
  • Erfahrung mit Social-Media-Management-Tools wie Agorapulse (oder vergleichbaren Tools) ist hilfreich
  • Ein Grundverständnis von SEO bzw. GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) ist ein Plus – vor allem aber hast du Lust, dich in dieses Thema als eigenes kleines Projekt einzuarbeiten und es aktiv mitzugestalten
  • Du interessierst dich für die Energiewende und hast Lust, dieses Thema jeden Tag ein Stück greifbarer zu machen

Benefits

  • Du hast die Möglichkeit in unserem schicken Showroom in der Hamburger Innenstadt zu arbeiten und/oder remote

Jobbeschreibung

Intermate x SAMY – Shaping the State of Social

Intermate gehört zu den größten Social-Media- und Influencer-Agenturen im DACH-Raum. Mit mehr als 250 Mates in Berlin, Hamburg, Köln und Remote entwickeln wir Social-First-Strategien, produzieren Content in eigenen Studios, arbeiten eng mit Creator:innen zusammen und steuern Kampagnen datengetrieben über unsere eigene Technologie. Unsere Kund:innen sind einige der bekanntesten Marken der Welt – von Lifestyle über FMCG bis hin zu Tech.

Als Teil von SAMY, einem globalen Agenturnetzwerk für Social Media und Creator Marketing, sind wir mit über 970 Expert:innen an 20 Standorten vernetzt. Das eröffnet internationale Perspektiven, Projekte in rund 55 Märkten und die Möglichkeit, dich weit über Ländergrenzen hinweg weiterzuentwickeln.

💡 👉 Hinweis: Unser Bewerbungsprozess wird teilweise von einem KI-gestützten Assistenten begleitet, der das erste Kennenlerngespräch führt. Weitere Informationen erhältst du im Verlauf deiner Bewerbung.

WAS DU MACHST

  • Fachliche Verantwortung für Buchhaltungsvorbereitung und Monatsabschlüsse – sauber, termingerecht, abschlussreif
  • Schrittweises Insourcing der aktuell extern geführten Buchhaltung
  • Maßgebliche Mitarbeit bei der NetSuite-Einführung: Prozessdesign, Datenmigration, Systemlogik
  • Reporting an Geschäftsführung und unsere Muttergesellschaft (SAMY Group)
  • Fachlicher Rückhalt und Weiterentwicklung des Accounting-Teams

DAS SOLLTEST DU WISSEN

  • Wir sind PE-finanziert (seit 2025) – Reporting-Anforderungen und Prozessumbau laufen parallel. Phasenweise anspruchsvoll
  • Operative Mitarbeit ist Realität. Der strategische Anteil wächst – ersetzt Hands-on aber nicht.
  • Fachkarriere, keine Führungskarriere. Du gehst fachlich voran und führst über Kompetenz, nicht über Personalverantwortung
  • Wir arbeiten vollständig remote – gelebter Alltag, kein Kompromiss. Du kannst also remote arbeiten oder in einem der drei Büros in Berlin, Hamburg oder Köln.

Gleichzeitig bekommst du einen Gestaltungsraum, den die wenigsten Inhouse-Rollen bieten: Du baust das Fundament – Prozesse und Struktur – für das Insourcing und NetSuite von Grund auf mit. Deine Zahlen gehen direkt an die Geschäftsführung und in die SAMY-Group, und du prägst die Automatisierungs- und Reporting-Ebene mit. Kurz: Du baust etwas auf, statt Bestehendes zu verwalten – und wer das über Jahre weiterentwickeln will, ist hier genau richtig.

Stellenanforderungen

WAS DU BRAUCHST

Mehrjährige, tiefgehende Accounting-Erfahrung – sowohl hands-on im laufenden Geschäft als auch im Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung robuster Prozesse.

  • Abschlusssicher nach HGB (Erstellung bzw. abschlussreife Vorbereitung für den StB).
  • Solides fachliches Fundament: Dein abgeschlossenes wirtschaftswissenschaftliches Studium mit Schwerpunkt Rechnungswesen bildet die Basis – alternativ eine eine abgeschlossene Bilanzbuchhalterprüfung mit entsprechender tiefer Berufserfahrung. Entscheidend ist, dass du die Logik und Zusammenhänge hinter den Zahlen verstehst (GuV, Bilanz, doppelte Buchführung), nicht nur die Ausführung einzelner Buchungen.
  • Sehr gute IT-Kenntnisse: sicher in Excel/Google Sheets, idealerweise SQL-Anwenderkenntnisse – und zwingend Erfahrung mit ERP-Systemen (idealerweise NetSuite), im Prozessaufbau wie in der operativen Anwendung.
  • Souveränes Stakeholdermanagement: Du kannst viele parallele Anforderungen priorisieren und kommst mit knappen Deadlines klar, ohne dabei auf Qualität zu verzichten.
  • Deutsch und Englisch verhandlungssicher (Gruppensprache ist Englisch).
  • Souveräner, realistischer Umgang mit AI-Tools: du weißt, was sie können, wo ihre Grenzen liegen und wie du sie effizient und zielgerichtet einsetzt.

Nice-to-have

  • Erfahrung in Agentur, Scale-up oder mittelständischem Dienstleister.

Persönlich suchen wir jemanden, der eine dynamische und schnelllebige Situation eigenständig strukturiert, fachlich führen kann, ohne Vorgesetzter zu sein (überzeugen statt anordnen), eine hohe Toleranz für Hands-on-Arbeit mitbringt und ehrlich mit eigenen Wissenslücken umgeht. Im Remote-Setup arbeitest du dabei selbstständig, strukturiert, verlässlich und ergebnisorientiert.

WAS WIR DIR BIETEN

  • Onboarding & Support
    No one likes to be the new kid. Mit strukturiertem Onboarding, einem persönlichen Mate und Zugang zu Lernmaterialien bist du ab Tag eine:r von uns.
  • Erstklassige Ausstattung
    Can’t work without my iPhone. Mit MacBook, iPhone und aktueller Apple-Tech arbeitest du flexibel und effizient. Das gilt für unsere Altbau-Offices genauso wie zuhause oder unterwegs.
  • Wachstum & Weiterentwicklung
    Rise & shine, darling! Dein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget gibt dir die Freiheit, in Workshops, Seminare, zertifizierte Kurse oder Coachings zu investieren. So entwickelst du dich genau in die Richtung, die zu deinen Zielen passt.
  • Flexibel arbeiten
    „Ob das bei euch gerade genauso ist? I doubt it!” Bis zu sechs Wochen im Jahr kannst du innerhalb der EU remote arbeiten. Unsere flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodelle machen es leicht, Arbeit und Leben in Einklang zu bringen. Bei einem Umzug oder in besonderen Lebenssituationen wie einem Trauerfall erhältst du zusätzliche freie Tage.
  • Mehr Freizeit
    „It’s my birthday, I’mma spend my money.“ An deinem Geburtstag heißt es: Laptop zu und genießen. Zusätzlich sind der 24. Dezember und der 31. Dezember frei. Jubiläen und Geburtstage feiern wir mit kleinen Überraschungen.
  • Health & Wellbeing

Mit der Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft entscheidest du selbst, ob Yoga, Pilates, Schwimmen oder Krafttraining zu deinem Glow Up passt. nilo.health sorgt für mentale Stärke und bietet Sessions mit Psycholog:innen oder Coaches. Über deinen Zugang können auch bis zu fünf Familienmitglieder mitmachen.
  • Exklusive Deals & Extras
    It’s giving… perks! Profitiere von attraktiven Rabatten bei Partnern wie plantclub, FutureBens und vielen mehr. Zusätzlich kannst du eines dieser drei Benefits wählen:
  • Givve Card – 50 € Guthaben pro Monat, frei einsetzbar für alles, was du liebst.
  • Mobiko – 65 € monatliches Mobilitätsbudget, nutzbar für Deutschlandticket, Tankkosten und alles, was kostet, um von A nach B zu kommen.
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge – 50 € monatlicher Zuschuss zu deiner betrieblichen Altersvorsorge.

Außerdem sind unsere Offices dog-friendly. Snacks, Obst und Drinks stehen allen Mates jederzeit kostenlos zur Verfügung.

Our solution is live in 40+ countries, used by 550+ customers, and automates 70,000+ processes every day, including for Fortune 500 companies. As one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scaleups, our success stems from deep expertise in technology and business processes, delivering a product with outstanding product-market fit, proven by a growing global customer base.

Location

This is a full-time position. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (if you are not located in the Zurich area), the role will be based remotely from Germany or Austria or onsite in Zurich.
As team collaboration is of great importance to us, we highly encourage remote team members to join us in Zurich at least once a month — these visits are financially supported by BLP.

Your Mission

As a versatile professional with a passion for technology, you’ll operate at the intersection of business and tech — leading end-to-end implementations of our Native-AI-powered ERP automation products. You’ll help customers reimagine their processes, maximize automation rates, and turn their AI initiatives into measurable success.

If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, take pride in driving results with full ownership, and want your work to have real business impact every single day, this role is made for you.

  • Own the implementation journey end-to-end — from understanding client requirements to ensuring smooth delivery, high customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement.

  • Translate complexity into clarity — design scalable, tailored solutions that align with customer workflows and business goals.

  • Collaborate closely with our engineering team to tackle technical challenges, adapt the system to customers’ unique processes, and ensure successful integration with existing systems.

  • Be the client’s trusted partner — anticipate needs, surface insights, and ensure they realise the full potential of blp’s automation.

What We’re Really Looking For

The following key attributes ensure success in this role:

What You Bring

Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One+, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert.

Bist Du bereit für Lösungen, die mehr als nur ein Versprechen sind und täglich echte Lebensqualität in tausende Haushalte bringen? Was du bei Enpal gestaltest, liefert morgen sauberen Strom und verändert nachhaltig, wie wir Energie nutzen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du bereitest strategische Unterlagen für C-Level Check-ins vor und unterstützt das Management direkt bei der Entscheidungsfindung.

  • Du konzipierst und implementierst skalierbare Vertriebs- und Operations-Prozesse, um unsere Produkte deutschlandweit erfolgreich auszurollen.

  • Du moderierst interne Workshops, um zusätzliche Wachstumspotenziale zu identifizieren und das Zusammenspiel innerhalb der Organisation zu heben.

Dein Profil

  • Du befindest dich in einem fortgeschrittenen oder hast ein sehr erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Bachelor/Masterstudium an einer Top-Tier Business School

  • Du verfügst über Arbeitserfahrungen oder Praktika in schnell wachsenden Unternehmen wie z.B. Startups oder in einer Unternehmensberatung/Consulting

  • Du zeichnest dich durch eine proaktive und stark lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise aus

  • Stark analytische Arbeitsweise mit der Kompetenz, komplexe Probleme zu dekonstruieren und Botschaften strukturiert (Top-down) zu vermitteln

  • Du beherrschst Deutsch und Englisch fließend in Wort und Schrift

Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️

Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen

  • Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit.

  • Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten.

  • Das ideale Setup für deinen Fokus - Wir sind überzeugt, dass exzellente Ergebnisse dort entstehen, wo die Bedingungen stimmen. Deshalb setzen wir auf ein hybrides Arbeitskonzept, das dir die Freiheit gibt, immer genau so zu arbeiten, wie es am besten zu deinen Aufgaben passt. Du brauchst neue Impulse auf internationalem Niveau? Mit Workflex bieten wir, abhängig von deiner Verantwortung, die Möglichkeit, deine Tätigkeit bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr ins Ausland zu verlegen.

  • Grown-up Business & Startup Spirit - In unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain findest du von höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Tischtennisplatte bis gefüllten Getränkekühlschränken und Barista-Coffee alles was das Herz begehrt.

  • Dein Kick-start bei Enpal - Onboarding-Tag mit Welcome Bag, Buddy-Programm und einem Team, das dich wirklich abholt.

  • Bleib auf dem Laufenden & gestalte mit - Transparente All-Hands, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedback-Kultur, denn ohne Fehler gibt es keinen Fortschritt.

  • Energiewende geht nur gemeinsam - Bei Enpal erwartet dich ein legendärer Teamspirit und unvergessliche Team- und Companyevents.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Executive - French Speaking based in Germany.

As an Account Executive, you will turn qualified product demonstrations into new, active, and transacting customers within a fast-growing global B2B marketplace. You will own the full commercial journey from discovery and demo through negotiation, contract closure, compliance, onboarding, and early customer activation. Beyond closing deals, you will be responsible for helping customers establish strong purchasing habits during their first 90 days. You will work closely with SDRs and Account Managers to ensure seamless handoffs and a strong customer experience. The role combines consultative selling, commercial negotiation, operational follow-through, and account activation. You will join a globally distributed sales organization where ownership, speed, customer relationships, and measurable results are highly valued.


Accountabilities
  • Run discovery-led product demonstrations that connect the marketplace's capabilities to each retailer's specific purchasing workflow, business needs, and commercial objectives.
  • Manage the full sales cycle from proposal and commercial terms through objection handling, stakeholder alignment, negotiation, and contract closure.
  • Build trusted relationships with prospective customers and clearly communicate the value of broader supplier access, competitive pricing, product selection, and marketplace efficiency.
  • Drive KYC and compliance processes through to completion, proactively following up on documentation and resolving onboarding obstacles without losing sales momentum.
  • Own the customer journey throughout the first 90 days, helping new accounts move from initial searches and quotations to their first orders and repeat purchases.
  • Focus on customer activation and long-term value rather than simply closing and handing off newly signed accounts.
  • Partner with SDRs to ensure strong qualification and effective handoffs before and after demonstrations.
  • Coordinate with Account Managers to provide detailed account context, purchasing patterns, opportunities, and potential risks ahead of the day-90 transition.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline stages, activity records, and forecasts, ensuring commercial reporting reflects the true state of opportunities.
  • Monitor and improve key performance indicators including demo-to-close conversion, new business revenue, KYC completion time, 90-day activation, account value, and forecast accuracy.

    • Requirements

    • 3–6 years of proven experience in a closing sales role, ideally within a marketplace, transactional B2B/B2C platform, or the jewellery and diamond industry with meaningful commercial exposure.
    • Strong understanding of marketplace dynamics, including liquidity, supply breadth, customer trust, transaction mechanics, and the importance of driving an initial transaction to establish long-term purchasing behaviour.
    • Experience selling solutions based on customer workflows and business outcomes rather than relying on feature-led product presentations.
    • Excellent discovery, presentation, demonstration, negotiation, objection-handling, and closing skills.
    • Commercially minded and comfortable managing pricing discussions, contractual terms, and pushback from customers and multiple stakeholders.
    • Strong operational discipline and willingness to own post-sale activities such as KYC, compliance, onboarding, and activation.
    • Ability to manage a pipeline effectively, prioritize opportunities, and maintain accurate forecasts in a fast-paced environment.
    • Customer-focused approach with the ability to build credible, long-term relationships with businesses of different sizes.
    • Strong ownership, resilience, adaptability, and attention to detail, with the ability to maintain momentum across multiple deals and customer journeys.
    • Excellent communication skills in French and English, with the ability to communicate confidently with international customers and internal stakeholders.
    • Comfortable working independently in a globally distributed, low-hierarchy environment where initiative and measurable impact are highly valued.

Overview

As SCADA Engineering Manager, you take technical ownership of SCADA, monitoring, plant control and communication systems for our utility-scale PV and BESS projects. You act as the central technical interface between engineering, project teams, customers, grid operators and external suppliers such as Gantner or meteocontrol — ensuring these systems are correctly specified, integrated, tested and commissioned.

This role combines strong technical understanding with coordination and stakeholder management: you translate between grid operator requirements, customer expectations, supplier solutions and EPC project realities. 
Most importantly, when a plant reaches commissioning, you ensure SCADA, PPC and communication systems work reliably — rather than becoming the project's last unresolved interface.


Your mission

  • Technical ownership of SCADA, monitoring, plant control and communication systems
  • Supplier management — coordinating SCADA/PPC providers (e.g. Gantner, meteocontrol) and holding them accountable for correct specification, integration and delivery

Your profile

  • Degree in electrical engineering, automation engineering, control engineering, mechatronics, computer engineering, or a comparable technical discipline

Job description

We are seeking an experienced Senior DevOps Consultant to support a defined project at our Headquarters in Berlin.

The assignment is focused on the set-up and further development of our data management and infrastructure platform. The initial consulting engagement is planned for six months, with the possibility of extending the assignment for a further period, potentially up to 12 months in total, subject to project requirements and mutual agreement. The consultant will provide specialist DevOps and data-platform expertise within the scope of the project. The assignment is structured as an independent consulting engagement, with responsibility for delivering agreed project outcomes and technical solutions.

The project supports our Climate Policy Team, which is engaged in various projects on climate change mitigation, in particular on energy system transformation, evaluation of emissions scenarios, the 1.5°C global warming limit and evaluation of national climate action. This includes flagship projects such as the Climate Action Tracker and the National Pathways Explorer, for which data is processed and analysed in-house and then published on the respective project websites.

As part of the assignment, the consultant will work on the shared data platform and infrastructure used across the organisation. Our platform is self-hosted on our own hardware and currently runs PostgreSQL, MinIO, GitLab CI/CD and containerised workloads on Linux. The consultant is expected to organise and perform the assignment independently, within the agreed project scope and in coordination with relevant project stakeholders.
Your responsibilities

  • Build and operate the data platform for advanced analytics and climate modelling, spanning DevOps and data engineering work.
  • Take the platform from single-server deployments to properly separated environments, with orchestration and infrastructure as code.
  • Establish and improve the platform's operational practices, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, capacity planning and performance optimisation.
  • Design and implement the access, identity and secrets model across platform and shared infrastructure.
  • Contribute to the standardisation of production data workflows and platform standards across the organisation.
  • Document what you build (runbooks, architecture notes and handover material) to ensure continuity.
  • Provide technical guidance to data analysts and scientists and support the adoption of good practice in DataOps, security and governance.
  • Evaluate new tools and technologies, run proof-of-concepts, and help define the technical roadmap for our infrastructure.


Your profile

Relevant Tech Skills
Required:

  • Python and shell scripting.
  • Linux servers in production.
  • Container orchestration you have operated yourself, including cluster setup and upgrades (Kubernetes, Docker).
  • Infrastructure as Code and configuration management (Ansible, or equivalent).
  • Operational experience with PostgreSQL (backup and point-in-time recovery, tested restores, version upgrades and connection pooling).
  • Monitoring tools (like Prometheus, Grafana) and alert design.
  • A solid understanding of distributed systems in an on-premise context.
Nice to have:
  • S3-compatible object storage operations (MinIO, Ceph).
  • Identity and directory services like LDAP, Keycloak, or SSO integration across self-hosted tools.
  • Virtualisation platforms (Proxmox, KVM).
  • Have actively applied data governance principles to manage data quality, security, and compliance, and understand how to implement controls that protect sensitive information.
  • Some experience deploying AI projects.
Qualifications
You will ideally have the following qualifications and skills:
  • You have more than 5 years of experience operating Linux servers in production, including on-premise or bare-metal environments (not exclusively managed cloud).
  • Proven ability to build automated pipelines that streamline development, testing and deployment for data-related projects.
  • You are an excellent troubleshooter who excels at diagnosing and fixing data infrastructure and identifying performance bottlenecks.
  • A strong communicator who can collaborate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders in a diverse, interdisciplinary and international environment.
  • Passionate about working at the intersection of Climate Science and Data Engineering (tell us about relevant projects you’ve worked on!).
  • Organised, detail-oriented, and motivated self-starter with strong analytical skills.
  • Proven ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with project stakeholders.
  • Good communication skills in English.


Our offer

Conditions
Application Deadline: The position remains open until filledExpected start of assignment: As soon as possible, by mutual agreement.Location: We would prefer the consultant to be based in Berlin to facilitate effective project coordination, technical collaboration and onboarding, particularly during the initial phase of the assignmentTerms: We are looking for a senior consultant for 6 months with the possibility of extension to up to 12 months in total, subject to project requirements, funding and mutual agreement.
Please apply with your CV and cover letter in PDF format exclusively using the application form at the earliest opportunity. Please indicate in your cover letter your earliest possible start date and your expected daily rate.
Applications by email or by post can unfortunately not be processed. We encourage you to apply using the application form.

At Mycolever, we are building the powerhouse for sustainable fungal biocompounds, unlocking the biodiversity of fungi to supercharge the industrial bioeconomy. Our journey begins with our biosurfactant platform, where we develop sustainable alternatives to petrochemical-based surfactants.

Ingredient by ingredient, our compound discovery platform unlocks the Fungal Kingdom and delivers highly functional biocompounds. Formulation by formulation, we help our customers minimize their environmental footprint and shape a greener future together.

Who You'll Work With

You will work directly with our founders. Britta Winterberg (CEO/CTO) drives our technological vision, with deep expertise in fungal biotechnology and fermentation. You'll join the Sell Online Tribe, the group shaping how merchants bring their businesses to life online. We design and build tools that help millions of entrepreneurs, from barbers to bakers, sell their products and services anywhere.

You'll be working on some of SumUp's biggest merchant-facing online products as part of the Bifrost team, contributing to growing and scaling critical products like Payment Links and Gift Cards, while also working on integration products that provide essential features used across many other SumUp products. They're high-traffic, high-responsibility products that other SumUp teams depend on too.

You'll join a small, cross-functional team and take on genuine ownership of the frontend - not just executing tickets, but shaping how the products evolve. With new features to ship and integration products to keep secure and current, there's real, meaningful work to get stuck into from day one.

What you'll do

  • Build and maintain frontend features across payment links, gift cards, and online checkout products, writing clean, testable, and maintainable code
  • Contribute to the development and upkeep of our integration products and SDKs, used by both internal teams and external partners
  • Take part in technical planning, design reviews, and sprint ceremonies - bringing your perspective on estimations, trade-offs, and improvements
  • Help reduce tech debt and improve application performance, observability, and accessibility as a foundation for future delivery
  • Monitor live services and respond to issues, providing redundancy for customer support requests reaching the team

You'll be great for this role if…

  • You have 5+ years of experience in TypeScript and JavaScript, with hands-on experience building production-grade React and Next.js applications (including SSR and app router patterns)
  • You have experience writing unit, integration, and end-to-end tests using tools like Jest, Vitest, or React Testing Library
  • You're comfortable working within CI/CD workflows and collaborating in agile environments (Scrum or Kanban)
  • You have experience with UI libraries such as Radix or shadcn, and a solid understanding of accessibility and UX best practices
  • You have a product mindset - someone who cares about the value delivered to merchants, not just the code written to get there, and who can work autonomously to drive complex features end-to-end

Why you should join SumUp

🌎 Opportunity to work in a truly global, multicultural team from our open, vibrant Cologne office, located in the heart of the city. This involves an office-first setup

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

About SumUp

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Über uns

myDartpfeil ist ein deutsches E-Commerce-Unternehmen mit Sitz in Berlin und Technologieführer im Onlinehandel für individuell konfigurierbare Dartpfeile. Mit unserem eigens entwickelten Dartpfeil-Konfigurator bieten wir Kundinnen und Kunden weltweit die Möglichkeit, ihre ganz persönlichen Darts zusammenzustellen – individuell, hochwertig und unkompliziert.

Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2017 haben wir uns kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt und gehören heute zu den innovativsten Anbietern im boomenden Dartssegment. Wir verkaufen über unseren eigenen Shop (Shopify Plus), Amazon und B2B-Partner – und ein wesentlicher Teil unserer Wertschöpfung entsteht direkt bei uns im Haus, von der UV-Flachbett- und Textilveredelung über Lasergravuren bis zur Endkonfektion.

Stellenausschreibung

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in Berlin suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die mit einem der Gründer zusammen unser Marketing ganzheitlich verantwortet: Du steuerst ein jährliches Media-Budget von über 1 Mio. Euro über Paid Ads, entwickelst CRM, SEO und neue Kanäle weiter – und baust dabei Prozesse auf, in denen AI-Tools fester Bestandteil der täglichen Arbeit sind.

Aufgaben

  • Paid Ads: Planung, Steuerung und Skalierung unserer Kampagnen auf Meta und Google (Search, Shopping, PMax, YouTube) – Budgetverantwortung von über 1 Mio. Euro pro Jahr, inklusive Testing, Attribution und laufender Optimierung auf ROAS und Neukundenkosten
